lee
/liː/
核心：背风处、避风处 —— 山、墙等挡住风的那一面；（航海）下风的一侧。
① We ate our lunch in the lee of a stone wall.
= 我们在一道石墙的背风处吃了午饭。
in the lee of something = 在…的背风处
② The small boats sheltered on the lee side of the island.
= 小船躲在岛的背风一侧。
the lee side = 背风的一侧
与 windward（迎风的）相对。

leech
/liːtʃ/
核心：水蛭、蚂蟥 —— 吸血的软体虫，旧时用来给病人放血；（贬）吸血鬼、靠别人过活的人。
① She found a leech on her leg after walking through the wet grass.
= 走过湿草地之后，她发现腿上叮着一条蚂蟥。
a leech = 水蛭
② Doctors once used leeches to take blood from sick people.
= 医生过去用水蛭给病人放血。
use leeches = 用水蛭
③ He called his cousins leeches who lived off the old man's money.
= 他说他那些表亲是靠老人的钱过活的吸血鬼。
a leech = （贬）吸血鬼

leek
/liːk/
核心：韭葱 —— 像大号葱的蔬菜，白色的茎粗而长，叶子扁平；威尔士的象征。
① She made a pot of leek and potato soup for lunch.
= 她煮了一锅韭葱土豆汤当午饭。
leek and potato soup = 韭葱土豆汤
② Wash the leeks well, because soil gets between the leaves.
= 把韭葱好好洗洗，叶子之间会夹着泥。
wash the leeks = 洗韭葱
威尔士人在三月一日佩戴它。

leer
/lɪə(r)/
核心：色眯眯地看、不怀好意地斜眼看 —— 常说 leer at；名词：这样的眼神或笑。
① The drunk man at the next table kept leering at the waitress until the owner threw him out.
= 邻桌那个醉汉一直色眯眯地盯着女服务员，直到老板把他赶了出去。
leer at somebody = 色眯眯地看某人
② He looked her up and down with an unpleasant leer and offered to buy her a drink.
= 他带着令人不舒服的色相把她上下打量了一番，说要请她喝一杯。
an unpleasant leer = 令人不舒服的色相
贬义，被看的人会觉得受冒犯。

leery
/ˈlɪəri/
核心：（口语）提防的、信不过的 —— 常说 leery of。
① She is leery of anyone who offers to lend her money.
= 谁说要借钱给她，她都留个心眼。
be leery of somebody = 提防某人
② Investors are leery of putting more money into the company.
= 投资者不大敢再往那家公司里投钱。
be leery of doing something = 不大敢做…
同 wary，更口语。

leeward
/ˈliːwəd/
核心：背风的、在下风处的；向下风。名词：下风的一侧。
① Rain falls on the mountains, so the leeward slopes behind them stay dry all year.
= 雨都落在山上，所以山后背风的坡面终年干燥。
the leeward slopes = 背风的坡面
② The boat drifted to leeward when the engine stopped.
= 发动机一停，船就往下风方向漂。
to leeward = 往下风方向
水手多读作 loo-erd。

leeway
/ˈliːweɪ/
核心：回旋余地、自由活动的空间；（英）落后的距离、耽误的时间。
① The teachers are given a lot of leeway in how they teach the course.
= 教师在怎么教这门课上有很大的回旋余地。
give somebody leeway = 给某人回旋余地
② The deadline leaves us very little leeway if anything goes wrong.
= 这个期限没给我们留多少余地，万一出点差错就来不及。
little leeway = 余地很小
③ He has a lot of leeway to make up after three weeks off school.
= 他三个星期没上学，落下的功课有不少要补。
make up leeway = （英）补上落后的部分
本义是船被风吹偏的距离。

left
/left/
核心：左边的；向左；左边、左侧；the left / the Left（政治上的左派）。与 right 相对。
（left 也是 leave 的过去式，见 leave 条。）
搭配与派生：left-hand（左手边的）、left-hand drive（方向盘在左的）、left-handed（左撇子的；用左手的）、
left-handedness（左撇子）、left-hander（左撇子；左手的一击）、left wing（左翼；左边锋位置）、left-winger（左翼人士；左边锋）、
left-of-centre（中间偏左的）、left field（美：棒球左外场；out of left field = 出人意料）、
left luggage office（英：行李寄存处）。
① She writes with her left hand but throws a ball with her right.
= 她用左手写字，却用右手扔球。
your left hand = 左手
② Turn left at the traffic lights and then take the second road.
= 在红绿灯处左转，然后走第二条路。
turn left = 左转
③ The bank is on the left, just past the post office.
= 银行在左边，刚过邮局就是。
on the left = 在左边
④ Take the next left and follow the road to the end.
= 下一个路口左拐，沿着路走到头。
the next left = 下一个左拐的路口
⑤ The Left won the election for the first time in twenty years.
= 左派二十年来头一回赢得选举。
the Left = 左派
政治上主张平等、公有的一方。
⑥ The light switch is on the left-hand side of the door.
= 电灯开关在门的左手边。
left-hand = 左手边的
⑦ Most cars sold in Europe are left-hand drive.
= 在欧洲卖的车大多方向盘在左。
left-hand drive = 方向盘在左的
⑧ About one person in ten is left-handed.
= 大约十个人里有一个是左撇子。
left-handed = 左撇子的
⑨ Scientists do not fully understand what causes left-handedness.
= 科学家还没有完全弄清左撇子的成因。
left-handedness = 左撇子（这一特点）
⑩ The team's best bowler is a left-hander.
= 那支球队最好的投球手是个左撇子。
a left-hander = 左撇子
也指左手打出的一拳。
⑪ She belongs to the left wing of the party.
= 她属于党内的左翼。
the left wing = 左翼
⑫ He played on the left wing for his school team.
= 他在校队踢左边锋。
on the left wing = 在左边锋位置
⑬ The union leader is a well-known left-winger.
= 那位工会领袖是个有名的左翼人士。
a left-winger = 左翼人士
⑭ The country has had a left-of-centre government for ten years.
= 那个国家十年来一直由中间偏左的政府执政。
left-of-centre = 中间偏左的
⑮ Her question came out of left field and caught the minister by surprise.
= 她的问题来得出人意料，让部长措手不及。
out of left field = （美）出人意料
left field = （棒球）左外场
⑯ We put our bags in the left luggage office and went to see the city.
= 我们把包存在行李寄存处，去逛城了。
the left luggage office = （英）行李寄存处
这里的 left 是 leave 的过去分词：留下的行李。

leftie
/ˈlefti/
核心：（口语）左撇子；（英，口语，常贬）左派分子。也拼 lefty。
① Our son is a leftie, so we bought him special scissors.
= 我们儿子是左撇子，所以给他买了专用剪刀。
a leftie = （口语）左撇子
② His father calls anyone who reads that newspaper a lefty.
= 凡是看那份报纸的人，他父亲都管他们叫左派分子。
a lefty = （口语）左派分子
两种拼法、两个意思都通用。

leftist
/ˈleftɪst/
核心：左派的；左派分子。名词 leftism（左派思想）并入本条。
① The army removed the leftist government after only a year in power.
= 那个左派政府上台仅一年就被军队推翻了。
a leftist government = 左派政府
② Leftists and trade unions marched together through the capital.
= 左派人士和工会一起在首都游行。
a leftist = 左派分子
③ The book traces the rise of leftism among students in the 1960s.
= 那本书追溯了二十世纪六十年代左派思想在学生中的兴起。
leftism = 左派思想

leftmost
/ˈleftməʊst/
核心：最左边的 —— 只用在名词前。
① Click on the leftmost button at the top of the screen.
= 点击屏幕顶端最左边的按钮。
the leftmost button = 最左边的按钮
② The leftmost figure in the photograph is my grandfather as a young man.
= 照片上最左边的那个人是我祖父年轻的时候。
the leftmost figure = 最左边的人
-most 表示「最靠…的」，如 topmost。

leftover
/ˈleftəʊvə(r)/
核心：吃剩的饭菜（多用复数 leftovers）；（旧时期）残留下来的东西。形容词：剩下的。
① We had the leftovers from Sunday's dinner for lunch on Monday.
= 星期一午饭我们吃了星期天晚餐的剩菜。
leftovers = 剩饭剩菜
② She made a soup from the leftover chicken and vegetables.
= 她用剩下的鸡肉和蔬菜做了汤。
leftover chicken = 剩下的鸡肉
③ The law is a leftover from the days when few people had cars.
= 那条法律是没几个人有车的年代遗留下来的。
a leftover from something = …的遗留物

leftward
/ˈleftwəd/
核心：向左的；向左。副词也说 leftwards。也指政治上「向左转的」。
① The car made a sudden leftward turn across the traffic.
= 那辆车突然横穿车流向左拐。
a leftward turn = 向左转
② The road curves leftwards and then drops down to the sea.
= 那条路向左弯去，然后下坡通到海边。
curve leftwards = 向左弯
③ The party's leftward shift lost it the support of business.
= 那个党向左转，失去了工商界的支持。
a leftward shift = 向左转（政治上）

leg
/leɡ/
核心：腿；（裤子的）裤腿；（桌椅的）腿；（旅程、比赛的）一段、一程。
习语：pull somebody's leg（跟某人开玩笑、逗某人）、not have a leg to stand on（站不住脚、毫无根据）、
on its last legs（快不行了、快散架了）、stretch your legs（活动活动腿脚）、break a leg（祝演出成功）、
cost an arm and a leg（贵得要命）。
并入本条：leg-up（托一把；帮一把）、leg-pull（英：玩笑、捉弄）、leg warmer（暖腿套）。
① He broke his leg skiing and was on crutches for six weeks.
= 他滑雪摔断了腿，拄了六个星期拐杖。
break your leg = 摔断腿
② She sat down and crossed her legs.
= 她坐下来，翘起了二郎腿。
cross your legs = 翘腿
③ One leg of the table is shorter than the others.
= 那张桌子有一条腿比别的短。
a leg of the table = 桌子腿
④ I rolled up the legs of my trousers and walked into the sea.
= 我卷起裤腿，走进海里。
the legs of your trousers = 裤腿
⑤ We ordered a roast leg of lamb for the whole family.
= 我们给全家点了一只烤羊腿。
a leg of lamb = 羊腿
⑥ The last leg of the journey was a boat trip across the lake.
= 旅程的最后一段是坐船过湖。
a leg of a journey = 旅程的一段
⑦ Is it really true, or are you pulling my leg?
= 这是真的吗，还是你在逗我？
pull somebody's leg = 跟某人开玩笑
pull someone's leg = 逗某人（同上，口语里 someone 更常见）
⑧ Without the receipt, you do not have a leg to stand on.
= 没有收据，你就一点理也站不住。
not have a leg to stand on = 站不住脚
⑨ Our old washing machine is on its last legs.
= 我们那台旧洗衣机快不行了。
on its last legs = 快不行了
⑩ We stopped at a service station to stretch our legs.
= 我们在服务站停了车，活动活动腿脚。
stretch your legs = 活动活动腿脚
⑪ "Break a leg!" she whispered as he walked onto the stage.
= 他走上舞台时，她悄声说：“祝你演出成功！”
break a leg = 祝演出成功
剧场里忌讳直说 good luck。
⑫ The tickets for the final cost an arm and a leg.
= 决赛的门票贵得要命。
cost an arm and a leg = 贵得要命
⑬ He gave me a leg-up over the wall.
= 他托了我一把，让我翻过了墙。
a leg-up = 托一把
⑭ Her uncle's money gave her a leg-up when she started the business.
= 她创业时，叔叔的钱帮了她一把。
give somebody a leg-up = 帮某人一把
⑮ The story about the ghost in the cellar was just a leg-pull.
= 地窖里有鬼的那个说法不过是个玩笑。
a leg-pull = （英）玩笑、捉弄
⑯ The dancers wore pink leg warmers over their tights.
= 舞者们在紧身裤外面套着粉色的暖腿套。
a leg warmer = 暖腿套

legacy
/ˈleɡəsi/
核心：遗产、遗赠 —— 遗嘱里留给人的钱物；（前人、往事）留下的东西、影响。
① She received a small legacy from her aunt and used it to buy a piano.
= 她从姑妈那里得到一小笔遗产，用它买了一架钢琴。
a legacy from somebody = 某人留下的遗产
② The war left a legacy of hatred between the two villages.
= 那场战争在两个村子之间留下了仇恨。
a legacy of hatred = 遗留的仇恨
③ The bank still runs on legacy systems written forty years ago.
= 那家银行还在用四十年前写的老系统。
legacy systems = （计算机）遗留的老系统
这一支作定语：过时但还在用的。

legal
/ˈliːɡəl/
核心：法律上的、与法律有关的；合法的、法律许可的。副词 legally 并入本条。
搭配：legal aid（法律援助）、legal age（法定年龄）、legal tender（法定货币）、legal proceedings（诉讼）、
legal holiday（美：法定假日）、legal eagle（口语：精明能干的律师）、legal high（合法兴奋剂）、
（美）legal pad（黄色横格拍纸簿）、legal-size（美：法律文书尺寸的）。
① You should take legal advice before you sign anything.
= 签任何东西之前，你都应该先听听律师的意见。
legal advice = 法律意见
② Is it legal to park on this side of the street?
= 在街的这一边停车合法吗？
be legal = 合法
③ The company is legally required to keep the records for six years.
= 法律要求那家公司把记录保存六年。
legally required = 法律要求的
④ People who cannot afford a lawyer can apply for legal aid.
= 请不起律师的人可以申请法律援助。
legal aid = 法律援助
⑤ The legal age for buying alcohol is eighteen in this country.
= 在这个国家，买酒的法定年龄是十八岁。
the legal age = 法定年龄
⑥ The old notes will stop being legal tender in March.
= 旧钞票到三月就不再是法定货币了。
legal tender = 法定货币
⑦ The family has started legal proceedings against the builder.
= 那家人已经对那个建筑商提起了诉讼。
legal proceedings = 诉讼
⑧ The banks are closed on Monday because it is a legal holiday.
= 星期一是法定假日，银行不开门。
a legal holiday = （美）法定假日
⑨ The company hired a team of legal eagles to fight the case.
= 那家公司请了一班精明的律师打这场官司。
a legal eagle = （口语）精明能干的律师
⑩ The government banned several legal highs after a number of deaths.
= 出了几起死亡事件后，政府禁了几种所谓的合法兴奋剂。
a legal high = 合法兴奋剂
⑪ She wrote the first draft of the speech on a yellow legal pad.
= 她在一本黄色横格拍纸簿上写了讲稿的初稿。
a legal pad = （美）黄色横格拍纸簿
⑫ The printer takes both letter and legal-size paper.
= 那台打印机既能用信纸尺寸的纸，也能用法律文书尺寸的纸。
legal-size = （美）法律文书尺寸的
比普通信纸长一截。

legalese
/ˌliːɡəˈliːz/
核心：（口语，贬）法律术语、律师腔 —— 合同、法律文件里外行看不懂的文字。
① The contract is twenty pages of legalese that nobody in the family could follow.
= 那份合同是二十页的法律术语，家里没人看得懂。
pages of legalese = 满纸法律术语
② Can you explain the letter in plain English without the legalese?
= 你能不用那些律师腔，用大白话把这封信解释一下吗？
without the legalese = 不用律师腔
-ese 表示「某种行话」，如 journalese。

legalistic
/ˌliːɡəˈlɪstɪk/
核心：（贬）死抠法律条文的、拘泥于条文的。
① The company took a legalistic approach and refused to pay because one form was late.
= 那家公司死抠条文，因为一张表交晚了就拒绝付款。
a legalistic approach = 死抠条文的做法
② His legalistic reading of the rules ignores what they were written for.
= 他对规则的解读拘泥于字面，不顾当初定规则是为了什么。
a legalistic reading = 拘泥于字面的解读
是批评：守了条文，丢了本意。

legality
/liːˈɡælɪti/
核心：合法性 —— 某事是否合乎法律；（复数）法律上的手续、规定。
① The court will decide next week on the legality of the strike by the train drivers.
= 法院下周将就火车司机的那场罢工是否合法作出裁决。
the legality of something = …的合法性
② Lawyers on both sides are still working out the legalities of the sale of the farm.
= 双方的律师还在处理那座农场买卖的法律手续。
the legalities = 法律手续
这一支用复数。

legalize
/ˈliːɡəlaɪz/
核心：使合法化 —— 让原先违法的事变成法律许可的。名词 legalization 并入本条。英式也拼 legalise。
① The state voted to legalize the sale of the drug for medical use.
= 那个州投票决定让该药物的医用销售合法化。
legalize something = 使…合法化
② Divorce was legalized in the country in 1981.
= 那个国家在一九八一年使离婚合法化。
be legalized = 被合法化
③ Thousands marched in support of the legalization of same-sex marriage.
= 成千上万的人游行，支持同性婚姻合法化。
the legalization of something = …的合法化

legation
/lɪˈɡeɪʃən/
核心：公使馆 —— 级别低于大使馆的外交机构；公使馆的全体人员。
① The British legation stood in a walled garden near the old city gate.
= 英国公使馆坐落在老城门附近一座有围墙的花园里。
a legation = 公使馆
② The whole legation was ordered to leave the country within a week.
= 公使馆全体人员被勒令一周内离境。
the whole legation = 公使馆全体人员
今天各国多互设大使馆，这个词主要见于历史书。

legato
/lɪˈɡɑːtəʊ/
核心：（音乐）连奏、连音 —— 音与音之间平滑相连、不断开。与 staccato（断奏）相对。
① Play the opening bars legato, without any break between the notes.
= 开头几小节用连奏，音与音之间不要断开。
play legato = 连奏
② The singer is known for her smooth legato phrasing.
= 那位歌手以乐句连贯流畅著称。
legato phrasing = 连贯的乐句处理
意大利语「连在一起的」。

legend
/ˈledʒənd/
核心：传说、传奇故事；传奇人物；（地图、图表的）图例；（正式）（硬币、牌匾上的）铭文。
形容词 legendary（传说中的；大名鼎鼎的）并入本条。
① According to legend, a dragon once lived in the cave above the village.
= 相传村子上方的山洞里曾住着一条龙。
according to legend = 相传
② The children love the legend of Robin Hood.
= 孩子们很喜欢罗宾汉的传说。
the legend of Robin Hood = 罗宾汉的传说
③ She became a legend in her own lifetime.
= 她在世时就成了传奇人物。
a legend = 传奇人物
④ The legend at the bottom of the map explains the symbols.
= 地图底部的图例解释了各种符号。
the legend of a map = 地图的图例
⑤ The shop window carried the legend: closed until further notice.
= 那家店的橱窗上写着：暂停营业，另行通知。
the legend = 铭文、标示的文字
⑥ The band's concerts in the 1970s were legendary.
= 那支乐队二十世纪七十年代的音乐会是出了名的。
legendary = 大名鼎鼎的
⑦ The story tells of the legendary king who pulled a sword from a stone.
= 那个故事讲的是传说中从石头里拔出剑的国王。
a legendary king = 传说中的国王

legerdemain
/ˌledʒədəˈmeɪn/
核心：（正式）花招、障眼法；（变戏法的）手上功夫。
① The accounts hid the losses by a piece of financial legerdemain.
= 那些账目靠一手财务上的障眼法把亏损藏了起来。
financial legerdemain = 财务上的障眼法
② The magician's legerdemain with the cards amazed the children.
= 魔术师玩牌的手上功夫让孩子们看呆了。
legerdemain with cards = 玩牌的手上功夫
法语「手轻」；同 sleight of hand。

leggings
/ˈleɡɪŋz/
核心：紧身裤、打底裤 —— 贴身有弹性的女裤；（旧）护腿、绑腿。复数形式。
① She went for a run in black leggings and a T-shirt.
= 她穿着黑色紧身裤和 T 恤去跑步。
black leggings = 黑色紧身裤
② The farmer wore leather leggings to protect his legs from the thorns.
= 那位农夫打着皮绑腿，免得腿被荆棘刮伤。
leather leggings = 皮绑腿
这一支是旧式的：套在裤子外面护小腿的。

leggy
/ˈleɡi/
核心：（口语）腿长的 —— 多说女人、少年、小马；（植物）茎长得又细又长的。
① The magazine cover showed a leggy model in a short red dress.
= 杂志封面上是一位穿红色短裙的长腿模特。
a leggy model = 长腿模特
② Seedlings grow leggy if they do not get enough light.
= 幼苗光照不够就会徒长，茎又细又长。
grow leggy = （植物）徒长
这一支是园艺用语。

legible
/ˈledʒəbəl/
核心：（字迹、印刷）清楚可辨的、看得清的。名词 legibility 与副词 legibly 并入本条。
① Her handwriting is small but perfectly legible.
= 她的字很小，但完全看得清。
legible handwriting = 清楚可辨的字迹
② The date on the old coin was only just legible.
= 那枚古币上的日期勉强还能辨认。
just legible = 勉强能辨认
③ Please write your name and address legibly in capital letters.
= 请用大写字母把姓名和地址写清楚。
write legibly = 写得清楚
④ A larger font would improve the legibility of the menu.
= 字体大一点，菜单会更容易看清。
legibility = （字迹的）清晰可辨
反义 illegible。

legion
/ˈliːdʒən/
核心：（古罗马的）军团；（法国、西班牙等的）外籍军团之类的部队；（正式）大批、众多。形容词（文）：极多的。
名词 legionary（古罗马军团士兵）、legionnaire（外籍军团士兵）并入本条。
① A Roman legion had about five thousand soldiers.
= 一个罗马军团大约有五千名士兵。
a Roman legion = 罗马军团
② He ran away at eighteen and joined the French Foreign Legion.
= 他十八岁离家出走，加入了法国外籍军团。
the Foreign Legion = 外籍军团
③ Legions of fans waited outside the hotel in the rain.
= 大批歌迷冒雨等在酒店外面。
legions of fans = 大批歌迷
④ The problems facing the new manager are legion.
= 新经理面临的问题多得数不清。
be legion = （文）多得数不清
这一支作形容词，只放在 be 后面。
⑤ The museum shows the armour of a Roman legionary.
= 博物馆展出了一名罗马军团士兵的铠甲。
a legionary = 古罗马军团士兵
⑥ The old legionnaire still wore his white cap on parade days.
= 那位外籍军团老兵每逢阅兵日还戴着他的白帽子。
a legionnaire = 外籍军团士兵

legislate
/ˈledʒɪsleɪt/
核心：立法 —— 制定法律；常说 legislate for / against（立法保障 / 立法禁止）。名词 legislator（立法者、议员）并入本条。
① Parliament has the power to legislate on matters of health and safety.
= 议会有权就卫生和安全事务立法。
legislate on something = 就…立法
② The government promised to legislate against the sale of knives to children.
= 政府承诺立法禁止向儿童出售刀具。
legislate against something = 立法禁止…
③ You cannot legislate for every possible accident.
= 你不可能为每一种可能的事故都定好规矩。
legislate for something = 为…立法、预先作规定
④ State legislators voted to raise the age for buying cigarettes.
= 州议员投票决定提高买香烟的年龄。
a legislator = 立法者、议员

legislation
/ˌledʒɪˈsleɪʃən/
核心：法律、法规（总称）；立法（这一过程）。不可数，说一条用 a piece of legislation。
① New legislation on food safety comes into force next month.
= 关于食品安全的新法规下个月生效。
legislation on something = 关于…的法规
② It was the most important piece of legislation of the decade.
= 那是那十年里最重要的一项立法。
a piece of legislation = 一项法规
③ The government plans to introduce legislation to protect tenants.
= 政府计划提出保护租客的法案。
introduce legislation = 提出法案

legislative
/ˈledʒɪslətɪv/
核心：立法的、有立法权的 —— 只用在名词前。
① The country's legislative body has two hundred members.
= 那个国家的立法机构有两百名成员。
a legislative body = 立法机构
② The president has no legislative power and cannot make laws alone.
= 总统没有立法权，不能独自制定法律。
legislative power = 立法权
政府三权：legislative（立法）、executive（行政）、judicial（司法）。

legislature
/ˈledʒɪsleɪtʃə(r)/
核心：立法机关 —— 有权制定和修改法律的一群人，如议会、国会。
① The state legislature meets for only four months of the year.
= 那个州的议会一年只开四个月的会。
the state legislature = 州议会
② The bill was passed by both houses of the legislature.
= 那项法案在立法机关的两院都获得通过。
the legislature = 立法机关
美国各州的议会都叫这个。

legit
/lɪˈdʒɪt/
核心：（口语）合法的、正当的；真的、靠谱的 —— legitimate 的缩略。
① He swears that the business is completely legit.
= 他发誓说那桩生意完全合法。
be legit = （口语）合法、正当
② I thought the email was a trick, but the offer turned out to be legit.
= 我以为那封邮件是骗局，结果那个报价是真的。
turn out to be legit = 结果是真的
年轻人口语里也当「真棒」用。

legitimate
/lɪˈdʒɪtɪmət/
核心：合法的、法律认可的；正当的、合情合理的；（子女）婚生的。
副词 legitimately、名词 legitimacy（合法性、正当性）与动词 legitimize（使合法、使正当）并入本条。
① He is the legitimate owner of the painting and has the receipt from the gallery to prove it.
= 他是那幅画的合法主人，有画廊的收据为证。
the legitimate owner = 合法主人
② That is a perfectly legitimate question to ask a minister.
= 向部长提这个问题完全正当。
a legitimate question = 正当的问题
③ The old king had no legitimate children to follow him, so the crown passed to his brother.
= 老国王没有婚生子女继位，王位便传给了他弟弟。
legitimate children = 婚生子女
旧式说法，今天少用。
④ You can legitimately claim the cost of the train ticket.
= 火车票的钱你可以名正言顺地报销。
legitimately = 名正言顺地、合法地
⑤ Many people questioned the legitimacy of the election after thousands of votes went missing.
= 几千张选票不翼而飞之后，许多人质疑那场选举的合法性。
the legitimacy of something = …的合法性
⑥ The film was criticized for legitimizing violence.
= 那部电影因把暴力正当化而受到批评。
legitimize something = 使…显得正当

legless
/ˈleɡləs/
核心：没有腿的；（英，口语）烂醉如泥的。
① The slow-worm looks like a snake but is in fact a legless lizard.
= 蛇蜥看上去像蛇，其实是没有腿的蜥蜴。
a legless lizard = 没有腿的蜥蜴
② He was completely legless by the time the pub closed.
= 到酒馆打烊时，他已经烂醉如泥。
be legless = （英，口语）烂醉如泥
醉得站不住，像没了腿。

legroom
/ˈleɡruːm/
核心：（座位前）伸腿的空间。
① There is not much legroom in the back of the car.
= 那辆车后排伸腿的空间不大。
not much legroom = 伸腿的空间不大
② I paid extra for a seat with more legroom on the long flight.
= 那趟长途航班，我多花钱买了个腿部空间大些的座位。
more legroom = 更大的腿部空间
同类词：headroom（头顶空间）、elbow room。

legume
/ˈleɡjuːm/
核心：豆科植物；豆荚、豆子（指豌豆、菜豆、扁豆这类）。形容词 leguminous（豆科的）并入本条。
① Beans, peas and lentils are all legumes.
= 菜豆、豌豆和小扁豆都是豆类。
a legume = 豆类
② Farmers grow legumes to put nitrogen back into the soil.
= 农民种豆科植物，把氮补回土壤里。
grow legumes = 种豆科植物
③ Clover is a leguminous plant that is good food for cattle.
= 三叶草是一种豆科植物，是牛的好饲料。
a leguminous plant = 豆科植物

legwork
/ˈleɡwɜːk/
核心：（口语）跑腿的活儿 —— 费时费力、要到处走动搜集情况的基础工作。
① The junior reporters did the legwork, and the editor wrote the story.
= 跑腿的活儿是年轻记者干的，稿子是编辑写的。
do the legwork = 干跑腿的活儿
② Finding the right house took months of legwork.
= 找到合适的房子花了好几个月的奔波。
months of legwork = 几个月的奔波

lei
/leɪ/
核心：（夏威夷的）花环 —— 用鲜花串成、套在脖子上，欢迎客人时献上。
① Each visitor was given a lei of fresh flowers at the airport.
= 每位游客在机场都得到了一个鲜花花环。
a lei of flowers = 鲜花花环
② She took off the lei and hung it on the mirror in her hotel room.
= 她摘下花环，挂在酒店房间的镜子上。
take off the lei = 摘下花环
夏威夷语借词。

leisure
/ˈleʒə(r)/
核心：闲暇、空闲时间。习语 at leisure（有空时；从容地）、at your leisure（等你有空时、不必着急）。
形容词 leisured（有闲的）、名词 leisurewear（休闲服）并入本条；
搭配 leisure centre（英：休闲健身中心）、leisure suit（休闲套装）。
① She has little time for leisure since she started the new job.
= 自从干上新工作，她几乎没有闲暇。
time for leisure = 闲暇
② What do you do in your leisure time?
= 你空闲时间做什么？
leisure time = 空闲时间
③ Take the form home and fill it in at your leisure.
= 把表带回家，有空再慢慢填。
at your leisure = 等你有空时
④ After the conference, we were at leisure to explore the city.
= 会议结束后，我们有空在城里逛逛。
at leisure = 有空；从容地
⑤ The children go swimming at the leisure centre every Saturday.
= 孩子们每个星期六去休闲中心游泳。
a leisure centre = （英）休闲健身中心
⑥ The shop sells leisurewear such as jogging trousers and sweatshirts.
= 那家店卖运动裤、卫衣之类的休闲服。
leisurewear = 休闲服
⑦ In those days, only the leisured classes could afford to travel abroad.
= 那年月，只有有闲阶级才出得起国。
the leisured classes = 有闲阶级
⑧ He turned up at the party in a pale blue leisure suit from the 1970s.
= 他穿着一套二十世纪七十年代的淡蓝色休闲套装来参加聚会。
a leisure suit = 休闲套装

leisurely
/ˈleʒəli/
核心：从容的、不慌不忙的 —— 形容词，虽然以 -ly 结尾。
① On the last morning of the holiday, we had a leisurely breakfast on the hotel balcony.
= 假期的最后一个早晨，我们在酒店阳台上从从容容地吃了顿早饭。
a leisurely breakfast = 从容的早饭
② The old couple walked at a leisurely pace along the river, stopping to watch the boats.
= 那对老夫妇沿着河不紧不慢地走着，不时停下来看船。
at a leisurely pace = 不紧不慢地
作副词时说 in a leisurely way。

leitmotif
/ˈlaɪtməʊtiːf/
核心：（音乐）主导动机 —— 歌剧里代表某个人物或主题、反复出现的乐句；（书、电影里）反复出现的主题。也拼 leitmotiv。
① Each character in the opera has a leitmotif that plays when he appears.
= 那部歌剧里每个人物都有一个主导动机，他一出场就响起。
a leitmotif = 主导动机
② The loss of a childhood home is the leitmotif that runs through all her novels.
= 失去童年的家，是贯穿她所有小说的主题。
the leitmotif of a novel = 小说里反复出现的主题
德语借词，因瓦格纳的歌剧而出名。

lemming
/ˈlemɪŋ/
核心：旅鼠 —— 北极地区的小型啮齿动物；（比喻）盲目跟风的人。
① Lemmings live under the snow and feed on moss and grass.
= 旅鼠生活在雪下，以苔藓和草为食。
a lemming = 旅鼠
② Investors followed each other like lemmings into the falling market.
= 投资者像旅鼠一样一个跟一个地冲进下跌的市场。
like lemmings = 像旅鼠一样盲目跟风
传说它们成群跳崖，其实并不属实。

lemon
/ˈlemən/
核心：柠檬；柠檬黄；（美，口语）老出毛病的次品（尤指汽车）；（英，口语）笨蛋。
形容词 lemony（有柠檬味的）并入本条；搭配 lemon-squeezer（榨柠檬器）、lemon sole（檬鲽）、
lemon balm（香蜂草）、lemon verbena（柠檬马鞭草）、（美）lemon law（次品车退换法）。
① Squeeze the juice of half a lemon over the fish.
= 把半个柠檬的汁挤在鱼上。
half a lemon = 半个柠檬
② She drinks hot water with a slice of lemon every morning.
= 她每天早上喝一杯加一片柠檬的热水。
a slice of lemon = 一片柠檬
③ The kitchen walls are painted pale lemon.
= 厨房的墙刷成了淡柠檬黄。
pale lemon = 淡柠檬黄
④ The car was a lemon that broke down every month.
= 那辆车是个次品，月月抛锚。
a lemon = （美，口语）老出毛病的次品
⑤ I stood there like a lemon while everyone else danced.
= 别人都在跳舞，我像个傻瓜似的站在那儿。
like a lemon = （英，口语）像个傻瓜
⑥ The sauce has a fresh, lemony taste.
= 那种酱汁有清新的柠檬味。
a lemony taste = 柠檬味
⑦ Use a lemon-squeezer to get the juice out without the pips.
= 用榨柠檬器挤汁，籽就不会掉进去。
a lemon-squeezer = 榨柠檬器
⑧ We ordered grilled lemon sole with new potatoes.
= 我们点了烤檬鲽配新土豆。
lemon sole = 檬鲽
一种扁平的海鱼，和柠檬无关。
⑨ She grows lemon balm by the kitchen door and makes tea with the leaves.
= 她在厨房门边种了香蜂草，用叶子泡茶。
lemon balm = 香蜂草
⑩ A few leaves of lemon verbena give the cake a wonderful smell.
= 几片柠檬马鞭草的叶子让蛋糕有了一股好闻的香味。
lemon verbena = 柠檬马鞭草
⑪ Under the state's lemon law, the dealer had to give him a new car.
= 根据那个州的次品车退换法，车商得给他换一辆新车。
a lemon law = （美）次品车退换法

lemonade
/ˌleməˈneɪd/
核心：（英）柠檬汽水 —— 有气的甜饮料；（美）柠檬水 —— 用柠檬汁、糖和水调的饮料。
① The children drank lemonade through straws at the party.
= 聚会上，孩子们用吸管喝柠檬汽水。
drink lemonade = 喝柠檬汽水
② She set up a table in front of the house and sold homemade lemonade.
= 她在屋前支了张桌子，卖自制的柠檬水。
homemade lemonade = 自制柠檬水
美国孩子夏天摆摊卖的就是它。

lemongrass
/ˈlemənɡrɑːs/
核心：柠檬草、香茅 —— 有柠檬香气的热带草，东南亚菜里常用。
① The soup is flavoured with lemongrass, ginger and chilli.
= 那道汤用柠檬草、姜和辣椒调味。
flavoured with lemongrass = 用柠檬草调味
② Crush the stalk of lemongrass with the back of a knife before adding it.
= 下锅前先用刀背把柠檬草的茎拍一拍。
a stalk of lemongrass = 一根柠檬草

lemur
/ˈliːmə(r)/
核心：狐猴 —— 马达加斯加的灵长类动物，脸像狐狸，尾巴很长。
① The ring-tailed lemur has a long tail with black and white bands.
= 环尾狐猴有一条黑白环纹相间的长尾巴。
a ring-tailed lemur = 环尾狐猴
② Lemurs live only on one large island off the coast of Africa.
= 狐猴只生活在非洲海岸外的一座大岛上。
lemurs = 狐猴

lend
/lend/
核心：借给、借出；（银行）贷款给；（正式）给…增添（某种气氛、分量）。过去式、过去分词 lent。
注意方向：lend 是「借出去」，borrow 是「借进来」。
习语：lend a hand（帮个忙）、lend an ear（听人诉说）、lend itself to（适合于、便于）、
lend support to（支持）、lend your name to（挂名支持）。
名词 lender（出借人、放款机构）、lending（放贷）并入本条；搭配 lending rate（贷款利率）、lending library（可外借的图书馆）。
① Could you lend me ten pounds until Friday?
= 你能借我十英镑吗？星期五还你。
lend somebody something = 借给某人…
② The museum has lent three of its best paintings to a gallery in Paris for the summer.
= 博物馆把最好的三幅画借给了巴黎的一家画廊，展一个夏天。
lend a painting to a gallery = 把画借给画廊展出
lent 是过去式。两种句型都行：lend + 人 + 物，或 lend + 物 + to + 人。
③ The bank refused to lend them the money for the new shop.
= 银行拒绝贷款给他们开新店。
the bank lends money = 银行放贷
④ Can you lend a hand with these boxes?
= 你能搭把手搬这些箱子吗？
lend a hand = 帮个忙
⑤ She is always ready to lend an ear when I have a problem.
= 我有了难处，她总愿意听我说说。
lend an ear = 听人诉说
⑥ The story lends itself to being made into a film.
= 那个故事很适合拍成电影。
lend itself to = 适合于、便于
⑦ The candles lent a romantic air to the room.
= 蜡烛给房间添了一份浪漫的气氛。
lend an air to something = 给…增添气氛
⑧ The new figures lend support to the idea that prices are falling.
= 新数据印证了物价在下跌的看法。
lend support to = 支持、印证
⑨ Several famous actors have lent their names to the campaign.
= 好几位著名演员挂名支持了那场运动。
lend your name to something = 挂名支持…
⑩ The bank is the largest mortgage lender in the country.
= 那家银行是全国最大的房贷放款机构。
a lender = 放款机构、出借人
⑪ Bank lending to small businesses fell last year.
= 去年银行对小企业的放贷减少了。
lending = 放贷
⑫ The bank raised its lending rate by half a per cent.
= 那家银行把贷款利率上调了半个百分点。
the lending rate = 贷款利率
⑬ The town has had a free lending library since 1890.
= 那座小城从一八九〇年起就有一座免费外借的图书馆。
a lending library = 可外借的图书馆

length
/leŋθ/
核心：长度；（时间的）长短；（书、文章的）篇幅；（绳、布、管子的）一段；（游泳池的）一个池长。
习语：at length（详尽地、长时间地；文：终于）、go to great lengths（不遗余力、想尽办法）、
the length and breadth of（…的四面八方、全境）、at arm's length（保持距离地；伸直手臂拿着）。
副词 lengthways（纵向地，也说 lengthwise）并入本条。
① The room is five metres in length and four in width.
= 那个房间长五米，宽四米。
five metres in length = 长五米
② The length of the film put many people off going to see it.
= 那部电影太长，很多人因此不想去看。
the length of a film = 电影的时长
③ He was surprised by the length of the queue outside the shop.
= 商店外面的队排得那么长，他很吃惊。
the length of the queue = 队伍的长度
④ She cut a length of string and tied the parcel with it.
= 她剪了一段绳子，用它把包裹捆好。
a length of string = 一段绳子
⑤ I swim thirty lengths of the pool three times a week.
= 我每周三次在泳池里游三十个池长。
thirty lengths = 三十个池长
⑥ The committee discussed the plan at length but reached no decision.
= 委员会把那个方案讨论了很久，却没作出决定。
at length = 详尽地、长时间地
⑦ She went to great lengths to keep the party a secret from him.
= 为了把聚会瞒着他，她费尽了心思。
go to great lengths = 不遗余力、想尽办法
⑧ He has travelled the length and breadth of the country selling books.
= 他走遍全国各地卖书。
the length and breadth of = …的全境
⑨ She has always kept her neighbours at arm's length.
= 她一向和邻居保持距离。
at arm's length = 保持距离地
⑩ Cut the carrots in half lengthways and roast them with honey.
= 把胡萝卜纵向对半切开，抹上蜂蜜烤。
lengthways = 纵向地

lengthen
/ˈleŋθən/
核心：加长、延长；变长。与 shorten 相对。
① I asked the tailor to lengthen the sleeves of the jacket by two centimetres.
= 我请裁缝把上衣的袖子放长两厘米。
lengthen the sleeves = 把袖子放长
② The days begin to lengthen in January, though the weather stays cold.
= 一月里白天开始变长，不过天气仍然寒冷。
the days lengthen = 白天变长
这一支不及物：自己变长。
③ The waiting time for an operation has lengthened to six months.
= 手术的等候时间已延长到六个月。
lengthen to six months = 延长到六个月
-en 把名词、形容词变成动词：strengthen、widen。

lengthy
/ˈleŋθi/
核心：冗长的、漫长的 —— 时间拖得很久；（文章、讲话）长篇累牍的。常带「太长」的意味。
① After lengthy talks, the two sides agreed on a price.
= 经过漫长的谈判，双方就价格达成了一致。
lengthy talks = 漫长的谈判
② Getting a visa can be a lengthy process that takes several months.
= 办签证有时是个漫长的过程，要花好几个月。
a lengthy process = 漫长的过程
③ He wrote a lengthy reply that covered six pages.
= 他写了一封长达六页的回信。
a lengthy reply = 长篇回复
long 只说长，lengthy 带点「拖得久」。

lenient
/liːniənt/
核心：宽大的、从轻的 —— 惩罚、执行规定时不严厉。名词 leniency 与副词 leniently 并入本条。
① The judge was lenient with him because it was his first offence.
= 因为是初犯，法官对他从轻发落。
be lenient with somebody = 对某人宽大
② Many people thought the sentence of two years was too lenient.
= 许多人认为两年的刑期太轻了。
a lenient sentence = 从轻的判决
③ His lawyer asked the court for leniency because of his age.
= 他的律师以他年纪大为由请求法庭从宽处理。
ask for leniency = 请求从宽
④ The school treats late homework more leniently in the first term.
= 那所学校在第一学期对迟交作业处理得比较宽。
treat something leniently = 从宽处理…

Leninism
/ˈlenɪnɪzəm/
核心：列宁主义 —— 列宁提出的政治、经济学说。形容词兼名词 Leninist（列宁主义的；列宁主义者）并入本条。
① The course covers the history of Leninism in Russia after 1917.
= 那门课讲的是一九一七年以后列宁主义在俄国的历史。
Leninism = 列宁主义
② The party was organized on Leninist principles, with a small group of leaders at the centre.
= 那个党是按列宁主义原则组织起来的，核心是一小批领导人。
Leninist principles = 列宁主义原则
③ Her grandfather was a committed Leninist who never changed his views.
= 她祖父是个坚定的列宁主义者，观点始终没变。
a Leninist = 列宁主义者

lens
/lenz/
核心：镜片、透镜；（相机的）镜头；（眼球的）晶状体；隐形眼镜（contact lens 的简称）。复数 lenses。
① I need new lenses for my glasses because my eyes have got worse.
= 我的视力变差了，眼镜得换新镜片。
lenses for glasses = 眼镜片
② She bought a long lens for photographing birds.
= 她买了一只拍鸟用的长焦镜头。
a long lens = 长焦镜头
③ The operation replaces the cloudy lens of the eye with a plastic one.
= 那种手术用塑料晶体换掉眼睛里混浊的晶状体。
the lens of the eye = 晶状体
④ He lost one of his lenses in the swimming pool.
= 他在游泳池里掉了一只隐形眼镜。
your lenses = 隐形眼镜
⑤ The book looks at the war through the lens of one small village.
= 那本书透过一个小村庄的视角来看那场战争。
through the lens of something = 透过…的视角
这一支是比喻。

lentil
/ˈlentəl/
核心：小扁豆、兵豆 —— 橙色、绿色或褐色的小圆扁豆子，晒干后煮汤、做炖菜。
① She made a thick lentil soup with carrots and onions.
= 她用胡萝卜和洋葱煮了一锅浓稠的小扁豆汤。
lentil soup = 小扁豆汤
② Red lentils cook in about twenty minutes and need no soaking.
= 红扁豆煮二十分钟左右就熟，不用泡。
red lentils = 红扁豆
素食者常用它代替肉。

lento
/ˈlentəʊ/
核心：（音乐）慢板 —— 缓慢地（演奏）；慢板乐章。
① The second movement is marked lento and lasts nearly ten minutes.
= 第二乐章标的是慢板，将近十分钟。
marked lento = 标着慢板
② The pianist played the lento with great feeling.
= 那位钢琴家把慢板乐章弹得很有感情。
the lento = 慢板乐章
意大利语「慢」。

Leo
/ˈliːəʊ/
核心：狮子座 —— 黄道第五宫；属狮子座的人（约七月二十三日至八月二十二日出生）。
① My sister was born on the first of August, so she is a Leo.
= 我姐姐生在八月一日，所以是狮子座。
be a Leo = 是狮子座的人
② According to the magazine, people born under Leo are proud and generous.
= 那本杂志说，狮子座的人骄傲而大方。
born under Leo = 生在狮子座
拉丁语「狮子」。

leonine
/ˈliːənaɪn/
核心：（文）像狮子的 —— 多形容人的头、头发、相貌有狮子般的气派。
① The conductor shook his leonine head of white hair as the music grew louder.
= 乐声渐强时，那位指挥晃动着他狮子般的满头白发。
a leonine head = 狮子般的头
② The old actor had a leonine face and a deep, slow voice.
= 那位老演员有一张狮子般威严的脸，嗓音低沉缓慢。
a leonine face = 狮子般的脸
同类词：feline（像猫的）、canine（像狗的）。

leopard
/ˈlepəd/
核心：豹 —— 非洲、亚洲的大型猫科动物，黄色皮毛上有黑色斑点。母豹 leopardess 并入本条。
习语 a leopard cannot change its spots（江山易改，本性难移）。
① The leopard dragged its kill up into the branches of a tree.
= 那头豹把猎物拖上了树杈。
a leopard = 豹
② He says he will stop lying, but a leopard cannot change its spots.
= 他说他不再撒谎了，可是江山易改，本性难移。
a leopard cannot change its spots = 本性难移
③ The leopardess hid her two cubs in a cave among the rocks.
= 母豹把两只幼崽藏在岩石间的一个洞里。
a leopardess = 母豹

leotard
/ˈliːətɑːd/
核心：（舞蹈、体操穿的）连体紧身衣 —— 从肩到大腿根，露出腿。
① The girls changed into leotards for their ballet class.
= 女孩们换上连体紧身衣去上芭蕾课。
change into a leotard = 换上连体紧身衣
② The gymnast wore a sparkling red leotard in the final.
= 那位体操选手在决赛中穿了一件闪亮的红色紧身衣。
a red leotard = 红色紧身衣
得名于十九世纪的法国杂技演员 Léotard。

leper
/ˈlepə(r)/
核心：麻风病人；（比喻）被人躲着、嫌弃的人。今天说病人多用 a person with leprosy。
① In the Middle Ages, lepers were forced to live outside the town walls.
= 中世纪时，麻风病人被迫住在城墙外面。
a leper = 麻风病人
② After the scandal, his old friends treated him like a leper.
= 丑闻之后，他的老朋友都像躲瘟神一样躲着他。
treat somebody like a leper = 像躲瘟神一样对某人
这一支是比喻，今天更常见。

lepidopterist
/ˌlepɪˈdɒptərɪst/
核心：鳞翅目昆虫学家 —— 研究蝴蝶和蛾子的人。
① The lepidopterist spent thirty years collecting butterflies in South America.
= 那位鳞翅目学家在南美采集了三十年蝴蝶。
a lepidopterist = 研究蝴蝶和蛾子的人
② As a keen amateur lepidopterist, the writer chased moths with a net every summer.
= 那位作家是个热心的业余蝶蛾爱好者，每年夏天都拿着网追蛾子。
an amateur lepidopterist = 业余蝶蛾研究者
希腊语：lepido-（鳞）加 ptera（翅）。

leprechaun
/ˈleprəkɔːn/
核心：（爱尔兰传说里的）矮妖精 —— 小老头模样，做鞋，藏着一罐金子。
① In the story, a farmer catches a leprechaun and demands his pot of gold.
= 故事里，一个农夫捉住了矮妖精，逼他交出那罐金子。
catch a leprechaun = 捉住矮妖精
② Children dress up as leprechauns in green hats for the parade.
= 游行时，孩子们戴上绿帽子扮成矮妖精。
dress up as a leprechaun = 扮成矮妖精
圣帕特里克节上常见的形象。

leprosy
/ˈleprəsi/
核心：麻风病 —— 损害皮肤和神经的慢性传染病。形容词 leprous（患麻风病的）并入本条。
① Leprosy can now be cured with a course of drugs lasting several months.
= 麻风病如今用几个月的药物疗程就能治好。
cure leprosy = 治好麻风病
② The nurse spent her life caring for people with leprosy in India.
= 那位护士一辈子在印度照顾麻风病人。
people with leprosy = 麻风病人
③ The old book describes the leprous beggars at the city gate.
= 那本旧书描写了城门口患麻风病的乞丐。
leprous = 患麻风病的

lesbian
/ˈlezbiən/
核心：女同性恋者；女同性恋的。名词 lesbianism（女同性恋）并入本条。
① She came out as a lesbian to her parents during her first year at university.
= 上大学的头一年，她向父母公开了自己是女同性恋。
a lesbian = 女同性恋者
② The film is about a lesbian couple who want to adopt a child.
= 那部电影讲的是一对想收养孩子的女同性恋伴侣。
a lesbian couple = 女同性恋伴侣
③ The novel was banned in 1928 because it dealt with lesbianism.
= 那部小说一九二八年被禁，因为它写了女同性恋。
lesbianism = 女同性恋
得名于希腊的莱斯沃斯岛，女诗人萨福的家乡。

lesion
/ˈliːʒən/
核心：（医）损伤、病变 —— 皮肤或器官上因受伤、疾病而受损的一处。
① The doctor found a small lesion on the skin of his back.
= 医生在他背部的皮肤上发现了一处小病变。
a lesion on the skin = 皮肤上的病变
② The scan showed lesions in the part of the brain that controls speech.
= 扫描显示，大脑里管说话的部位有病变。
lesions in the brain = 大脑里的病变
医生用词，日常说 cut、sore。

less
/les/
核心：较少的、更少的（little 的比较级）；副词：较不、不那么；代词：较少的量。介词：减去。
接不可数名词；可数名词严格说用 fewer，口语里常混用。
习语：more or less（或多或少、差不多）、no less than（多达、不少于）、less and less（越来越少）、
much less（更不用说）、less than（不到；一点也不）。
① You should eat less salt and drink more water.
= 你应该少吃盐，多喝水。
less salt = 少些盐
② The journey takes less time by train than by car.
= 这段路坐火车比开车用的时间少。
less time than = 比…少的时间
③ The second film was less interesting than the first.
= 第二部电影不如第一部有意思。
less interesting than = 不如…有意思
④ I see him less often now that he has moved away.
= 他搬走以后，我见他的次数少了。
less often = 不那么经常
⑤ The job took less than an hour.
= 那活儿不到一个小时就干完了。
less than an hour = 不到一小时
⑥ I have more or less finished the report.
= 那份报告我差不多写完了。
more or less = 差不多、或多或少
⑦ No less than half the class failed the exam.
= 班上不及格的竟有一半之多。
no less than = 多达
强调数量大得惊人。
⑧ She goes out less and less since her husband died.
= 丈夫去世后，她越来越少出门。
less and less = 越来越少
⑨ He can hardly walk, much less run a race.
= 他连路都走不稳，更不用说赛跑了。
much less = 更不用说
⑩ He was less than pleased to find us in his office.
= 发现我们在他办公室里，他很不高兴。
less than pleased = 很不高兴
委婉的反话。
⑪ You will get a month's pay, less tax.
= 你会拿到一个月的工资，要扣掉税。
less tax = 扣掉税
这一支是介词：减去。

lessee
/leˈsiː/
核心：（法律）承租人 —— 按租约租用房屋、土地、设备的一方。与 lessor（出租人）相对。
① The lessee must keep the building in good repair for the length of the lease.
= 在租约期内，承租人必须把建筑保持完好。
the lessee = 承租人
② Under the contract, the lessee of the car pays for the insurance.
= 按合同，那辆车的承租人负担保险费。
the lessee of something = …的承租人
-ee 表示「接受的一方」：employee、trainee。

lessen
/ˈlesən/
核心：减少、减轻；变少、变轻。名词 lessening 并入本条。
① The new road has lessened the traffic through the village.
= 新路减少了穿村而过的车流。
lessen the traffic = 减少车流
② Eating well lessens the risk of heart disease.
= 吃得健康能降低得心脏病的风险。
lessen the risk = 降低风险
③ The pain lessened after she took the tablets.
= 她吃了药片之后，疼痛减轻了。
the pain lessens = 疼痛减轻
这一支不及物。
④ There has been no lessening of tension between the two countries.
= 两国之间的紧张关系毫无缓和。
a lessening of tension = 紧张的缓和

lesser
/ˈlesə(r)/
核心：较小的、次要的、较轻的 —— 只用在名词前，或 the lesser of。副词用法见于 lesser-known（不太出名的）。
习语 the lesser of two evils（两害相权取其轻）、to a lesser extent（在较小程度上）。
① He was charged with the lesser offence of careless driving.
= 他被控的是较轻的罪名：疏忽驾驶。
the lesser offence = 较轻的罪名
② Neither candidate is good, so I voted for the lesser of two evils.
= 两个候选人都不行，我只好两害相权取其轻。
the lesser of two evils = 两害之中较轻的一个
③ The law affects farmers and, to a lesser extent, shop owners.
= 那项法律影响农民，也在较小程度上影响店主。
to a lesser extent = 在较小程度上
④ The gallery also shows some of the painter's lesser-known works.
= 那家画廊还展出那位画家一些不太出名的作品。
lesser-known = 不太出名的
不能说 lesser than；比较时用 less。

lesson
/ˈlesən/
核心：一节课；（复数）课程；教训；（教堂里读的）一段经文。
习语：learn your lesson（吸取教训）、teach somebody a lesson（给某人一个教训）。
① The first lesson on Monday morning is maths, followed by an hour of French.
= 星期一上午的第一节课是数学，接着是一小时法语。
the first lesson = 第一节课
② She is taking driving lessons with her uncle in the car park behind the factory.
= 她在工厂后面的停车场跟叔叔学开车。
take driving lessons = 上驾驶课
take lessons = 上课、跟人学
③ The accident taught him a lesson about driving too fast.
= 那次事故让他明白了开快车的后果。
teach somebody a lesson = 给某人一个教训
④ I forgot my umbrella and got soaked, so I have learned my lesson.
= 我忘了带伞，淋得透湿，这下长记性了。
learn your lesson = 吸取教训
⑤ There are lessons to be learned from the failure of the project.
= 那个项目的失败有教训可以吸取。
lessons to be learned = 可吸取的教训
⑥ Let that be a lesson to you not to leave your bike unlocked.
= 这回你该记住了，自行车不能不锁。
let that be a lesson to you = 这回你该记住了
⑦ The headmaster read the lesson at the Christmas service in the village church.
= 在村教堂的圣诞礼拜上，校长读了经文。
read the lesson = 读经文
⑧ The flood was an object lesson in the dangers of building on a marsh.
= 那场洪水是在沼泽上盖房子有多危险的活教材。
an object lesson = 活生生的实例

lessor
/leˈsɔː(r)/
核心：（法律）出租人 —— 按租约把房屋、土地、设备租给别人的一方。与 lessee（承租人）相对。
① The lessor agrees to repair the roof if it leaks during the lease.
= 出租人同意，租期内屋顶若漏水由其负责修理。
the lessor = 出租人
② The airline does not own its planes but rents them from a lessor in Ireland.
= 那家航空公司没有自己的飞机，是向爱尔兰的一家租赁商租的。
rent something from a lessor = 向出租方租…
-or 表示「做的一方」：donor、vendor。

lest
/lest/
核心：（正式或文）以免、唯恐 —— 后面的从句常用 should 或动词原形。
① She closed the window quietly, lest the baby should wake.
= 她轻轻关上窗户，以免把婴儿吵醒。
lest the baby should wake = 以免婴儿醒来
② He wrote the number down lest he forget it.
= 他把号码写下来，免得忘了。
lest he forget = 免得他忘了
从句用动词原形（虚拟式），不加 -s。
③ They were afraid lest the soldiers should come back before morning.
= 他们唯恐士兵天亮前回来。
afraid lest… = 唯恐…
今天口语里说 in case 或 so that … not。

let
/let/
核心：让、允许 —— let somebody do something（不带 to）；let's（咱们…吧，let us 的缩略）；（英）出租（房屋）。
过去式、过去分词都是 let。不用被动，被动说 be allowed to。
短语动词：let down（让人失望；放下；放气）、let off（放过、从轻发落；放（烟花、枪））、let out（放出去；发出（叫声）；
把衣服放大；英：出租）、let in（放进来）、let in on（让…知道内情）、let in for（让…惹上麻烦）、
let into（放进；让…知道（秘密））、let on（泄露、说出去）、let up（减弱、停歇）。
习语：let alone（更不用说）、let go（松手；放开；解雇）、let me see（让我想想）、let somebody know（告诉某人）、
let yourself go（放开玩；不修边幅）、let it be（随它去）。
名词 letting（英：出租的房屋；出租）并入本条。
① Her parents let her stay out until midnight on Saturdays.
= 她父母允许她星期六在外面待到半夜。
let somebody do something = 让某人做…
② Let me carry that heavy bag up the stairs for you.
= 我来帮你把那个沉包拎上楼吧。
let me do something = 让我来…
客气地提出帮忙。
③ Let's go for a walk before it gets dark.
= 趁天还没黑，咱们去散散步吧。
let’s = let us 的缩略，咱们…吧
否定是 let's not。
④ Shut the gate behind you, and don't let the dog out of the garden.
= 随手把大门关上，别让狗跑出花园。
let something out of a place = 让…从某处出去
⑤ Let me see, where did I put my glasses?
= 让我想想，我把眼镜放哪儿了？
let me see = 让我想想
⑥ Let me know if you need any help with the move.
= 搬家要是需要帮忙，告诉我一声。
let somebody know = 告诉某人
⑦ He cannot boil an egg, let alone cook a meal for six.
= 他连鸡蛋都不会煮，更不用说给六个人做一顿饭了。
let alone = 更不用说
⑧ Hold on tight and don't let go of the rope.
= 抓紧了，别松开绳子。
let go = 松手、放开
⑨ The company had to let twenty workers go last month.
= 那家公司上个月不得不解雇了二十名工人。
let somebody go = 解雇某人
委婉说法。
⑩ I promised to help, and I will not let you down.
= 我答应过帮忙，不会让你失望的。
let down = 让人失望
⑪ Someone let down the tyres of his car during the night.
= 夜里有人把他汽车的轮胎放了气。
let down the tyres = 给轮胎放气
⑫ The police let him off with a warning.
= 警察警告了他一下就把他放了。
let off = 放过、从轻发落
⑬ The boys were letting off fireworks in the street.
= 男孩们在街上放烟花。
let off fireworks = 放烟花
⑭ She let out a scream when she saw the spider.
= 她看见那只蜘蛛，发出一声尖叫。
let out = 发出（叫声）
⑮ Before going to bed, he let the cat out and locked the back door.
= 睡觉前，他把猫放出去，锁上了后门。
let the cat out = 把猫放出去
⑯ She had lost her key, so she knocked on the kitchen window, and I let her in.
= 她丢了钥匙，便敲了敲厨房的窗户，我放她进来了。
let somebody in = 放某人进来
⑰ They finally let me in on the plan for the surprise party.
= 他们终于让我知道了惊喜聚会的计划。
let in on = 让…知道内情
⑱ I did not know what I was letting myself in for when I said yes.
= 我答应的时候，不知道自己会惹上多大的麻烦。
let in for = 让…惹上麻烦
常说 let yourself in for。
⑲ I'll let you into a secret: the boss is leaving next month.
= 我告诉你一个秘密：老板下个月要走。
let into = 让…知道（秘密）
⑳ She knew about the birthday present weeks before but did not let on to her brother.
= 她几个星期前就知道生日礼物的事，却没向弟弟透露。
let on = 泄露、说出去
㉑ The rain did not let up all day, so the match was moved to Sunday.
= 雨一整天都没停歇，比赛只好改到星期天。
let up = 减弱、停歇
㉒ It is your holiday, so relax and let yourself go.
= 这是你的假期，放松点，尽情玩吧。
let yourself go = 放开玩
也指「不修边幅、不再打理自己」。
㉓ They let the flat above the shop to a young couple.
= 他们把商店楼上的公寓租给了一对年轻夫妇。
let a flat = （英）出租公寓
美式说 rent out。门口牌子上写 To Let（招租）。
㉔ The agency has several holiday lettings near the beach.
= 那家中介有几处靠近海滩的度假出租房。
a letting = （英）出租的房屋

lethal
/ˈliːθəl/
核心：致命的、能致人死地的；（口语）极危险的、威力极大的。副词 lethally 并入本条。
① The snake's bite contains a lethal dose of poison.
= 那种蛇咬一口，毒液的量足以致命。
a lethal dose = 致死剂量
② The police found a knife and other lethal weapons in the car.
= 警察在车里搜出一把刀和其他致命武器。
a lethal weapon = 致命武器
③ Ice on the roads and thick fog made a lethal combination.
= 路面结冰加上大雾，这两样凑在一起极其危险。
a lethal combination = 极危险的组合
④ The striker has a lethal left foot.
= 那位前锋有一只威力极大的左脚。
a lethal left foot = 威力极大的左脚
这一支是体育记者的夸张说法。
⑤ The gas is lethally poisonous even in small amounts.
= 那种气体即使量很小也有致命的毒性。
lethally poisonous = 毒性致命的

lethargy
/ˈleθədʒi/
核心：没精打采、昏昏沉沉 —— 提不起劲、什么都不想做的状态。形容词 lethargic 并入本条。
① The heat filled everyone with lethargy, and the streets were empty by noon.
= 炎热让人人昏昏沉沉，到中午街上已空无一人。
fill somebody with lethargy = 让某人昏昏沉沉
② It took him weeks to shake off the lethargy that followed the illness.
= 他花了好几个星期才摆脱病后的那种无精打采。
shake off the lethargy = 摆脱无精打采
③ I always feel lethargic after a big lunch.
= 我午饭吃多了总是昏昏欲睡。
feel lethargic = 没精打采、昏昏欲睡
④ The market was lethargic, with few buyers and little trade.
= 市场很沉闷，买家少，成交也少。
a lethargic market = 沉闷的市场

letter
/ˈletə(r)/
核心：信、函件；字母。动词（多用被动）：在…上写字、印字。
习语：to the letter（一丝不苟、不折不扣地）、the letter of the law（法律的字面条文，与 the spirit 相对）。
并入本条：letterbox（英：门上的投信口；邮筒）、letterhead（信笺抬头）、lettering（书写、印刷的字体）、
letter bomb（信件炸弹）、letter carrier（美：邮递员）、letter opener（拆信刀）、letter of credit（信用证）、
letter-perfect（美：一字不差的）、letter-size（美：信纸尺寸的）。也写作两个词的 letter box 意思相同。
① I wrote a letter to the bank to complain about the charges.
= 我给银行写了封信，投诉那些收费。
write a letter to somebody = 给某人写信
② There is a letter for you on the kitchen table.
= 厨房桌上有你的一封信。
a letter for you = 你的一封信
③ There are twenty-six letters in the English alphabet.
= 英语字母表有二十六个字母。
a letter = 字母
④ Write your name in capital letters at the top of the form.
= 在表格顶端用大写字母写上你的名字。
capital letters = 大写字母
⑤ She followed the instructions to the letter.
= 她一丝不苟地照说明做了。
to the letter = 一丝不苟地
⑥ The company obeyed the letter of the law but ignored its spirit.
= 那家公司守了法律的字面条文，却无视其精神。
the letter of the law = 法律的字面条文
⑦ The van was lettered with the name of the bakery in gold.
= 那辆货车上用金字印着面包店的名字。
be lettered with something = 印着…字样
⑧ The postman pushed the parcel through the letterbox.
= 邮递员把包裹从投信口塞了进来。
the letterbox = （英）投信口
a letter box = 投信口（分开写的写法）
⑨ The reply came on paper with the hospital's letterhead.
= 回信用的是印有医院抬头的信笺。
a letterhead = 信笺抬头
⑩ The sign was painted in gold lettering on a black board.
= 那块招牌是在黑板上用金色字体漆的。
gold lettering = 金色的字
⑪ A letter bomb was sent to the minister's office.
= 有人给部长办公室寄了一枚信件炸弹。
a letter bomb = 信件炸弹
⑫ The letter carrier brings the mail at about ten every morning.
= 邮递员每天上午十点左右送信。
a letter carrier = （美）邮递员
⑬ She slit the envelope with a silver letter opener.
= 她用一把银拆信刀划开了信封。
a letter opener = 拆信刀
⑭ The seller asked for a letter of credit from the buyer's bank.
= 卖方要求买方的银行开具信用证。
a letter of credit = 信用证
⑮ After a month of practice, her speech was letter-perfect.
= 练了一个月，她的演讲一字不差。
letter-perfect = （美）一字不差的
⑯ The printer is loaded with letter-size paper.
= 打印机里装的是信纸尺寸的纸。
letter-size = （美）信纸尺寸的
美国的标准纸张，比 A4 略短略宽。

lettuce
/ˈletɪs/
核心：生菜、莴苣 —— 叶子生吃、拌沙拉的蔬菜。
① Wash the lettuce and dry the leaves before you make the salad.
= 拌沙拉之前先把生菜洗净，把叶子弄干。
wash the lettuce = 洗生菜
② I'd like a cheese sandwich with lettuce and tomato, please.
= 请给我一个奶酪三明治，加生菜和番茄。
with lettuce and tomato = 加生菜和番茄
说一棵用 a lettuce 或 a head of lettuce。

leukaemia
/luːˈkiːmiə/
核心：白血病 —— 血液里白细胞异常增多的癌症。美式拼 leukemia。
① The boy was treated for leukaemia at a children's hospital in London.
= 那个男孩在伦敦一家儿童医院治疗白血病。
be treated for leukaemia = 治疗白血病
② She raised thousands of pounds for research into childhood leukaemia.
= 她为儿童白血病研究筹了几千英镑。
childhood leukaemia = 儿童白血病
希腊语「白」加「血」。

levee
/ˈlevi/
核心：（美）防洪堤 —— 沿河筑起、挡洪水的土堤；河边的码头。
① The river broke through the levee and flooded half the town.
= 河水冲破防洪堤，淹了半座城。
break through the levee = 冲破防洪堤
② Workers piled sandbags on top of the levee as the water rose.
= 水位上涨时，工人们在堤顶码沙袋。
on top of the levee = 在堤顶
美国密西西比河一带的用词。

level
/ˈlevəl/
核心：水平、程度、级别；（水、地面的）高度；（楼的）层。形容词：平的、水平的；同样高的、齐平的；（比分）持平的。
动词：弄平；夷平；使持平；把（枪、批评）对准。英式过去式 levelled，美式 leveled。
短语动词：level off / level out（趋于平稳；变平）、level with（口语：对…说实话）、level at（把（枪）对准）、
level against（把（指责）对准，也说 level at）、level up（拉高到同一水平）、level down（拉低到同一水平）。
习语：on the level（口语：老实的、正当的）、a level playing field（公平的竞争环境）、do your level best（竭尽全力）。
形容词 level-headed（头脑冷静的）、副词 levelly（平静地、不动声色地）、名词 leveller（让人人平等的东西）并入本条。
① The level of noise in the factory is dangerous for the workers' hearing.
= 那家工厂的噪音水平对工人的听力有危险。
the level of noise = 噪音水平
② The river rose to its highest level for fifty years.
= 那条河涨到了五十年来的最高水位。
the highest level = 最高水位
③ She is studying French at an advanced level.
= 她在学高级法语。
at an advanced level = 在高级水平
④ The decision was taken at the highest level of the company.
= 那个决定是公司最高层作出的。
at the highest level = 在最高层
⑤ The car park is on level two of the shopping centre.
= 停车场在购物中心的二层。
level two = 二层
⑥ Put the tent up on a piece of level ground.
= 把帐篷搭在一块平地上。
level ground = 平地
⑦ The top of the wall is level with my shoulders.
= 墙头和我的肩膀一样高。
level with something = 与…齐平
⑧ The two teams were level at half-time.
= 中场休息时两队比分持平。
be level = 比分持平
⑨ The bombs levelled most of the old town.
= 炸弹把老城的大部分夷为平地。
level a town = 把城夷为平地
⑩ He scored twice to level the match at two goals each.
= 他连进两球，把比分扳成二比二平。
level the match = 把比分扳平
⑪ The robber levelled a gun at the cashier's head.
= 劫匪把枪对准了收银员的头。
level at = 把（枪）对准
⑫ Serious charges have been levelled against the minister.
= 有人对那位部长提出了严重的指控。
level against = 把（指责）对准
⑬ House prices rose quickly for years and then levelled off.
= 房价连涨了好几年，然后趋于平稳。
level off = 趋于平稳
⑭ The road climbs steeply for a mile and then levels out.
= 那条路陡着上坡一英里，然后变平了。
level out = 变平
⑮ I'll level with you: the company is in serious trouble.
= 我跟你说实话吧：公司的麻烦很大。
level with = （口语）对…说实话
⑯ The new law aims to level up wages in the poorer regions.
= 新法律旨在把较穷地区的工资拉高到同等水平。
level up = 拉高到同一水平
⑰ Critics say the reform will level down standards in the best schools.
= 批评者说，那项改革会把最好的学校的水准拉低。
level down = 拉低到同一水平
⑱ Are you sure this offer is on the level?
= 你确定这个报价是正当的吗？
on the level = （口语）老实的、正当的
⑲ Small shops want a level playing field with the big supermarkets.
= 小商店希望与大超市有公平的竞争环境。
a level playing field = 公平的竞争环境
⑳ I will do my level best to finish the job by Friday.
= 我会竭尽全力在星期五之前把活儿干完。
do your level best = 竭尽全力
㉑ She is a level-headed girl who never panics.
= 她是个头脑冷静的姑娘，从不慌张。
level-headed = 头脑冷静的
㉒ He looked at her levelly and said that he did not believe her.
= 他不动声色地看着她，说不相信她的话。
levelly = 平静地、不动声色地
㉓ Illness is a great leveller that strikes rich and poor alike.
= 疾病面前人人平等，富人穷人都逃不过。
a great leveller = 让人人平等的东西
㉔ The builder checked the shelf with a spirit level.
= 建筑工人用水平仪检查了那块搁板。
a spirit level = 水平仪
这一支是工具：看气泡在不在正中。

lever
/ˈliːvə(r)/
核心：操纵杆、控制杆；杠杆、撬棍；（比喻）施加压力的手段。动词：用杠杆撬。
① Pull the lever towards you to lower the seat.
= 把操纵杆往自己这边拉，座椅就降下来了。
pull the lever = 拉操纵杆
② We used a long iron bar as a lever to lift the stone.
= 我们用一根长铁棍当撬棍把石头撬了起来。
a lever = 撬棍、杠杆
③ The threat of a strike gave the union a lever in the pay talks.
= 罢工的威胁让工会在工资谈判中有了施压的筹码。
a lever in the talks = 谈判中的筹码
④ He levered the lid off the tin with a screwdriver.
= 他用螺丝刀把罐头盖子撬开了。
lever something off = 把…撬下来

leverage
/ˈlevərɪdʒ/
核心：影响力、筹码 —— 能让别人照你的意思办的力量；杠杆作用；（金融）举债经营的杠杆率。
动词：充分利用；举债收购。leveraged buyout（杠杆收购）并入本条。
① As the only buyer, the supermarket has a lot of leverage over the farmers.
= 作为唯一的买家，那家超市对农民有很大的制约力。
leverage over somebody = 对某人的影响力
② Use a longer spanner to get more leverage on the nut.
= 用长一点的扳手，拧螺母就更省力。
get more leverage = 得到更大的杠杆力
③ The firm plans to leverage its famous name to sell new products.
= 那家公司打算利用自己的名气来卖新产品。
leverage something = 充分利用…
商业用语里很流行。
④ The chain was sold in a leveraged buyout paid for mostly with borrowed money.
= 那家连锁店在一桩杠杆收购中被卖掉，收购的钱大多是借来的。
a leveraged buyout = 杠杆收购
⑤ High leverage made the bank's losses much worse when prices fell.
= 价格下跌时，高杠杆让那家银行的亏损严重了许多。
high leverage = 高杠杆率

leveret
/ˈlevərət/
核心：小野兔 —— 不满一岁的野兔（hare）。
① The dog found a leveret hiding in the long grass.
= 那条狗发现一只小野兔躲在深草里。
a leveret = 小野兔
② A hare leaves her leverets alone for most of the day and comes back at dusk to feed them.
= 母野兔白天大部分时间把幼兔单独留下，黄昏才回来喂奶。
her leverets = 她的幼兔
家兔的幼崽不叫这个，叫 kitten 或 bunny。

leviathan
/ləˈvaɪəθən/
核心：（《圣经》里的）海中巨兽；（文）庞然大物 —— 极大、极有势力的东西。
① The old sailors told stories of a leviathan that could swallow a ship.
= 老水手们讲过一头能吞下一条船的海中巨兽的故事。
a leviathan = 海中巨兽
② The oil company has grown into a leviathan with offices in sixty countries.
= 那家石油公司已长成庞然大物，在六十个国家设有办事处。
a leviathan = 庞然大物
这一支是比喻，说公司、机构、船只。

levitate
/ˈlevɪteɪt/
核心：（靠魔法、意念）悬浮、飘起来；使悬浮。名词 levitation 并入本条。
① The magician appeared to levitate a few inches above the stage.
= 那位魔术师看上去悬浮在离舞台几英寸的地方。
levitate above the stage = 悬浮在舞台上方
② She claimed that she could levitate objects with the power of her mind.
= 她声称能用意念让物体悬浮起来。
levitate objects = 让物体悬浮
③ The trick uses hidden wires to give the effect of levitation.
= 那个戏法用暗藏的钢丝造出悬浮的效果。
levitation = 悬浮

levity
/ˈlevɪti/
核心：（正式）轻浮、不庄重 —— 在该严肃的场合开玩笑、不当回事。
① The judge said that this was no time for levity.
= 法官说，这不是开玩笑的时候。
no time for levity = 不是开玩笑的时候
② His jokes brought a moment of levity to the long and difficult meeting.
= 他的笑话给那场漫长而艰难的会议带来了片刻轻松。
a moment of levity = 片刻轻松
与 gravity（庄重）相对。

levy
/ˈliːvaɪ/
核心：征收（税、罚款）—— 常说 levy a tax on；名词：征收的税款、费用。
① The government levied a new tax on sugary drinks.
= 政府对含糖饮料开征了一项新税。
levy a tax on something = 对…征税
② The court levied a fine of five thousand pounds on the company.
= 法院对那家公司处以五千英镑罚款。
levy a fine = 处以罚款
③ Airlines must pay a levy on every passenger who flies from the airport.
= 每有一位乘客从那个机场起飞，航空公司都要缴一笔费。
a levy on something = 对…征收的费用

lewd
/luːd/
核心：淫秽的、下流的 —— 粗俗地涉及性的。副词 lewdly 与名词 lewdness 并入本条。
① He was thrown out of the bar for making lewd remarks to the staff.
= 他因对店员说下流话被赶出了酒吧。
lewd remarks = 下流话
② The drunk men sang lewd songs on the last train home.
= 那几个醉汉在回家的末班火车上唱下流歌曲。
lewd songs = 下流歌曲
③ He winked lewdly at her across the room.
= 他隔着屋子下流地朝她挤了挤眼。
wink lewdly = 下流地挤眼
④ The man was fined for public lewdness in the park.
= 那个男人因在公园里有伤风化的行为被罚款。
public lewdness = 公然猥亵、有伤风化

lexical
/ˈleksɪkəl/
核心：（语言学）词汇的、与词有关的。副词 lexically 与名词 lexis（一门语言的全部词汇）并入本条；
术语 lexical meaning（词汇意义）、lexical unit（词汇单位）也并在这里。
① The two dialects have the same grammar but many lexical differences.
= 那两种方言语法相同，但词汇上差异很多。
lexical differences = 词汇差异
② The lexical meaning of a word is the meaning you find in a dictionary.
= 一个词的词汇意义就是词典里查到的那个意思。
lexical meaning = 词汇意义
与 grammatical meaning（语法意义）相对。
③ A phrasal verb is treated as a single lexical unit.
= 短语动词被当作一个词汇单位来处理。
a lexical unit = 词汇单位
④ The two languages are lexically similar, so speakers can read each other's newspapers.
= 那两种语言词汇上相近，所以说这两种话的人能看懂对方的报纸。
lexically similar = 词汇上相近
⑤ The course covers both the grammar and the lexis of business English.
= 那门课既讲商务英语的语法，也讲它的词汇。
lexis = （一门语言的）词汇

lexicography
/ˌleksɪˈkɒɡrəfi/
核心：词典编纂（学）—— 编写词典的工作和学问。名词 lexicographer（词典编纂者）并入本条。
① She has worked in lexicography for thirty years, mostly on learners' dictionaries.
= 她做了三十年词典编纂，主要是编学习词典。
work in lexicography = 从事词典编纂
② Computers have changed lexicography by giving editors millions of real examples.
= 计算机给编者提供了几百万条真实例句，改变了词典编纂。
change lexicography = 改变词典编纂
③ The lexicographer spent a whole week on the entry for one small word.
= 那位词典编纂者在一个小词的词条上花了整整一个星期。
a lexicographer = 词典编纂者

lexicon
/ˈleksɪkən/
核心：（某语言、某领域、某人的）全部词汇；（古希腊语等的）词典。
① Within a few years, the new word had entered the lexicon of everyday English.
= 没过几年，那个新词就进入了日常英语的词汇。
enter the lexicon = 进入词汇
② She has lost three elections, but failure is simply not a word in her lexicon.
= 她输过三次选举，可她的字典里根本没有失败这个词。
not in somebody's lexicon = 不在某人的字典里
③ He looked the verb up in a heavy Greek lexicon that had belonged to his grandfather.
= 他在一本沉甸甸的希腊语词典里查了那个动词，那词典原是他祖父的。
a Greek lexicon = 希腊语词典
这一支指书，多用于古代语言。

liability
/ˌlaɪəˈbɪlɪti/
核心：（法律上的）责任、义务；（复数）负债、债务；（口语）累赘、惹麻烦的人或物。
① The company accepted liability for the accident and paid the family's costs.
= 那家公司承认对事故负有责任，并支付了那家人的费用。
accept liability for something = 承认对…负有责任
② The firm's liabilities are greater than its assets.
= 那家公司的负债多于资产。
liabilities = 负债
与 assets（资产）相对。
③ Since his injury, he has become a liability to the team.
= 受伤以后，他成了球队的累赘。
a liability to the team = 球队的累赘
这一支说人或东西「帮不上忙还添乱」。

liable
/ˈlaɪəbəl/
核心：（法律上）负有责任的 —— liable for；可能…的、容易…的 —— liable to do；可能受到…的 —— liable to。
① You will be liable for any damage to the car while you are renting it.
= 租车期间，车有任何损坏都由你负责。
be liable for something = 对…负有责任
② The bridge is liable to flood after heavy rain.
= 大雨过后，那座桥容易被淹。
be liable to do something = 容易…、可能…
多指不好的事。
③ Anyone who parks here is liable to a fine of fifty pounds.
= 凡在此停车者，可处五十英镑罚款。
be liable to a fine = 可被处以罚款

liaise
/liˈeɪz/
核心：（尤英）联络、协调 —— 与别的部门、机构保持联系以便合作。常说 liaise with / between。
① The nurse liaises with the family and the doctors about the patient's care.
= 那位护士就病人的护理与家属和医生联络协调。
liaise with somebody = 与某人联络
② Her job is to liaise between the school and the parents.
= 她的工作是在学校和家长之间联络。
liaise between A and B = 在两方之间联络
由 liaison 倒推出来的动词。

liaison
/lɪˈeɪzən/
核心：联络、协作；联络人；（文）私通、暧昧关系。liaison officer（联络官）并入本条。
① There is close liaison between the police and the local schools.
= 警方与当地学校之间联络密切。
liaison between A and B = 两方之间的联络
② She acts as a liaison between the players and the club's owners.
= 她在球员和俱乐部老板之间充当联络人。
a liaison = 联络人
③ The novel describes a secret liaison between a doctor and a married woman.
= 那部小说写的是一个医生和一个有夫之妇的私情。
a secret liaison = 私情
④ The army sent a liaison officer to work with the aid agencies.
= 军队派了一名联络官去配合援助机构工作。
a liaison officer = 联络官

liar
/ˈlaɪə(r)/
核心：说谎的人、骗子。
① He called me a liar in front of the whole class.
= 他当着全班的面说我撒谎。
call somebody a liar = 说某人撒谎
② She is a good liar, and nobody guessed that the story was invented.
= 她很会撒谎，谁也没猜到那个故事是编的。
a good liar = 很会撒谎的人
来自 lie（说谎）；拼法是 -ar，不是 -er。

lib
/lɪb/
核心：解放运动 —— liberation 的口语缩略，只用在某些名称里，如 women's lib（妇女解放运动）。
① Her mother was active in women's lib in the 1970s.
= 她母亲在二十世纪七十年代很热心妇女解放运动。
women's lib = 妇女解放运动
② The magazine wrote about gay lib long before the big newspapers did.
= 那本杂志报道同性恋解放运动，比大报早得多。
gay lib = 同性恋解放运动
是那个年代的说法，今天听来有点旧。

libation
/laɪˈbeɪʃən/
核心：（古代的）奠酒 —— 祭神时洒的酒；（谑）酒、饮料。
① The priest poured a libation of wine onto the ground before the battle.
= 开战之前，祭司把酒洒在地上祭神。
pour a libation = 洒酒祭神
② After the meeting, we went to the pub for a few libations.
= 会后，我们去酒馆喝了几杯。
a few libations = （谑）几杯酒
这一支是开玩笑的文雅说法。

libel
/ˈlaɪbəl/
核心：（书面的）诽谤、诽谤罪 —— 白纸黑字损害他人名誉的不实之词；动词：（书面）诽谤。
口头的诽谤叫 slander。形容词 libellous（诽谤的，美式拼 libelous）并入本条。
① The actor sued the newspaper for libel and won.
= 那位演员以诽谤罪起诉那家报纸，打赢了。
sue somebody for libel = 以诽谤罪起诉某人
② She claims that she was libelled in an article about the charity.
= 她声称一篇关于那家慈善机构的文章诽谤了她。
be libelled = 被（书面）诽谤
③ The lawyers removed several libellous statements from the book.
= 律师们从书里删去了几处有诽谤之嫌的话。
libellous statements = 诽谤性的话

liberal
/ˈlɪbrəl/
核心：开明的、思想开放的；（政治上）自由派的；大方的、大量的；（教育）通识的。名词：自由派人士。
副词 liberally（大量地；开明地）、名词 liberality（慷慨；开明）与 liberal arts（文科、通识学科）并入本条。
① Her parents have a liberal attitude to what she wears.
= 她父母对她的穿着态度开明。
a liberal attitude = 开明的态度
② He is a liberal who supports higher taxes on the rich.
= 他是自由派，支持对富人多征税。
a liberal = 自由派人士
③ Add a liberal amount of pepper before you serve the soup.
= 汤上桌前多撒些胡椒。
a liberal amount = 大量
④ She is liberal with her praise but careful with her money.
= 她夸人很大方，花钱却很小心。
be liberal with something = 给…很大方
⑤ Spread the cream liberally over your arms and face.
= 把乳霜厚厚地抹在胳膊和脸上。
liberally = 大量地
⑥ He studied the liberal arts before going to law school.
= 上法学院之前，他学的是文科。
the liberal arts = 文科、通识学科
⑦ The old duke was famous for his liberality towards the poor of the town.
= 老公爵以对城里穷人的慷慨而出名。
liberality = 慷慨

liberalism
/ˈlɪbərəlɪzəm/
核心：自由主义 —— 主张个人自由、渐进改革的政治观点。
① Liberalism grew in the trading cities of Europe during the nineteenth century.
= 十九世纪，自由主义在欧洲的商业城市里发展起来。
liberalism = 自由主义
② The book attacks the economic liberalism of the 1980s for closing factories and mines.
= 那本书抨击二十世纪八十年代的经济自由主义让工厂和矿山关了门。
economic liberalism = 经济自由主义
-ism 表示「主义、学说」。

liberalize
/ˈlɪbərəlaɪz/
核心：放宽（法律、制度的限制）、使自由化。名词 liberalization 并入本条。英式也拼 liberalise。
① The government plans to liberalize the laws on shop opening hours.
= 政府打算放宽关于商店营业时间的法律。
liberalize the laws = 放宽法律
② Trade between the two countries was liberalized in the 1990s.
= 两国之间的贸易在二十世纪九十年代放开了。
be liberalized = 被放开
③ The liberalization of the airline industry brought cheaper flights.
= 航空业的自由化带来了更便宜的机票。
the liberalization of something = …的自由化

liberate
/ˈlɪbəreɪt/
核心：解放（国家、人）；使摆脱（束缚）。
名词 liberation（解放）、liberator（解放者）与形容词 liberated（解放了的；思想开放的）并入本条；
liberation theology（解放神学）也并在这里。
① The city was liberated by the army in August 1944 after four years of occupation.
= 被占领四年之后，那座城市在一九四四年八月被军队解放。
be liberated = 被解放
② Selling the business liberated him from years of worry.
= 卖掉生意让他摆脱了多年的操心。
liberate somebody from something = 使某人摆脱…
③ The crowd outside the gates cheered the liberation of the political prisoners.
= 大门外的人群为政治犯获得解放而欢呼。
the liberation of somebody = …的解放
④ The soldiers were welcomed as liberators by the people of the town.
= 城里的人把士兵当作解放者来欢迎。
a liberator = 解放者
⑤ She was a liberated woman who travelled alone across Asia in the 1920s.
= 她是个思想解放的女性，二十世纪二十年代就独自横穿亚洲旅行。
a liberated woman = 思想解放的女性
⑥ The priest was influenced by the liberation theology of Latin America.
= 那位神父受了拉丁美洲解放神学的影响。
liberation theology = 解放神学
主张教会站在穷人一边的神学思潮。

Liberian
/laɪˈbɪəriən/
核心：利比里亚的；利比里亚人。
① The ship sails under the Liberian flag, though its owners are Greek.
= 那艘船挂利比里亚国旗，船东却是希腊人。
the Liberian flag = 利比里亚国旗
国名是 Liberia，在西非。
② Thousands of Liberians returned home when the war ended.
= 战争结束后，成千上万的利比里亚人返回了家园。
a Liberian = 利比里亚人

libertarian
/ˌlɪbəˈteəriən/
核心：自由至上主义者 —— 主张个人自由越多越好、政府管得越少越好的人；这种主张的。
① As a libertarian, he believes that the government should not tax income at all.
= 他是自由至上主义者，认为政府根本不该征收入税。
a libertarian = 自由至上主义者
② The small party has a libertarian policy on drugs and wants to end all the bans.
= 那个小党在毒品问题上持自由放任的政策，想取消所有禁令。
a libertarian policy = 自由放任的政策
比 liberal 更彻底：连福利、管制都反对。

libertine
/ˈlɪbətiːn/
核心：（正式，贬）浪荡子、放荡的人 —— 尤指纵欲、不顾道德的男人。
① The play tells the story of a rich libertine who ruins every woman he meets.
= 那出戏讲的是一个有钱的浪荡子，他遇见的女人都被他毁了。
a libertine = 浪荡子
② He lived a libertine life in Paris until his money ran out.
= 他在巴黎过着放荡的日子，直到钱花光。
a libertine life = 放荡的生活
这里作定语。

liberty
/ˈlɪbəti/
核心：自由 —— 不受政府、他人束缚的权利；（一项具体的）自由权；冒昧、放肆的行为。
习语：at liberty（自由的、未被关押的；at liberty to do = 有权、可以做）、take the liberty of（冒昧地）、
take liberties（放肆；随意改动）。
① The new law is a threat to the liberty of every citizen.
= 那项新法律威胁到每个公民的自由。
the liberty of a citizen = 公民的自由
② The right to vote is one of our most important civil liberties.
= 选举权是我们最重要的公民自由权之一。
civil liberties = 公民自由权
③ I am not at liberty to tell you where she is.
= 我无权告诉你她在哪儿。
be at liberty to do something = 有权、可以做…
④ Two of the escaped prisoners are still at liberty.
= 越狱的囚犯里有两个仍然在逃。
at liberty = 未被关押的
⑤ I took the liberty of ordering a taxi for you.
= 我冒昧地替你叫了辆出租车。
take the liberty of = 冒昧地
⑥ The film takes liberties with the facts of the king's life.
= 那部电影对国王的生平随意改动。
take liberties = 随意改动；放肆

libido
/lɪˈbiːdəʊ/
核心：性欲。形容词 libidinous（正式：好色的、性欲强的）并入本条。
① Some drugs for high blood pressure can lower the libido.
= 有些降压药会降低性欲。
lower the libido = 降低性欲
② Loss of libido is a common sign of depression.
= 性欲减退是抑郁症的常见征兆。
loss of libido = 性欲减退
③ The novel was banned for its libidinous hero and frank scenes.
= 那部小说因主人公好色、场面露骨而被禁。
libidinous = 好色的

Libra
/ˈliːbrə/
核心：天秤座 —— 黄道第七宫；属天秤座的人（约九月二十三日至十月二十二日出生）。也说 Libran。
① He was born in early October, so he is a Libra.
= 他生在十月初，所以是天秤座。
be a Libra = 是天秤座的人
② Librans are said to hate arguments and love beautiful things.
= 据说天秤座的人讨厌争吵、喜爱美的东西。
a Libran = 天秤座的人
拉丁语「天平」。

librarian
/laɪˈbreəriən/
核心：图书馆管理员、馆员。名词 librarianship（图书馆学、图书馆工作）并入本条。
① The librarian helped me find a book about the history of the town.
= 图书馆员帮我找到了一本讲这座城历史的书。
the librarian = 图书馆员
② She worked as a school librarian for thirty years.
= 她当了三十年学校图书馆员。
a school librarian = 学校图书馆员
③ He took a course in librarianship after leaving university.
= 大学毕业后，他修了一门图书馆学课程。
librarianship = 图书馆学

library
/ˈlaɪbrəri/
核心：图书馆；（家里的）书房、藏书室；（个人的）藏书、收藏；（计算机）程序库。
① I borrowed three books from the library on Saturday.
= 星期六我从图书馆借了三本书。
borrow a book from the library = 从图书馆借书
② The old house has a library with shelves from floor to ceiling.
= 那座老房子有一间藏书室，书架从地板顶到天花板。
a library = 藏书室
③ He has built up a large library of jazz records.
= 他积攒了一大批爵士唱片收藏。
a library of records = 一批唱片收藏
④ The program uses a free library for drawing charts.
= 那个程序用一个免费的库来画图表。
a library = （计算机）库
⑤ She spent the afternoon in the reference library looking at old maps.
= 她一下午都在资料图书馆里看老地图。
a reference library = 资料图书馆
书只能在馆内看、不外借。

libretto
/lɪˈbretəʊ/
核心：（歌剧、音乐剧的）剧本、唱词。复数 librettos 或 libretti。作者叫 librettist，并入本条。
① The composer wrote the music, and a poet wrote the libretto.
= 作曲家写了音乐，一位诗人写了唱词。
write the libretto = 写歌剧唱词
② The opera has wonderful music but a weak libretto.
= 那部歌剧音乐很美，剧本却弱。
a weak libretto = 弱的剧本
③ The librettist based the story on an old French play.
= 那位剧本作者把故事建立在一出法国老戏上。
a librettist = 歌剧剧本作者
意大利语「小书」。

license
/ˈlaɪsəns/
核心：（动词）给…发许可证、批准。名词 licence（许可证、执照）英式拼 licence，美式名词动词都拼 license。
形容词 licensed（有执照的；获准卖酒的）、名词 licensee（持照人，尤指酒馆老板）并入本条；
搭配 licensing laws（英：售酒法规）、license plate（美：车牌）、license number（美：车牌号）、
licensed victualler（英，正式：持照卖酒的店主）。
① The restaurant is licensed to sell wine and beer.
= 那家餐馆获准出售葡萄酒和啤酒。

② The drug has not yet been licensed for use in children.
= 那种药尚未获准用于儿童。
be licensed for use = 获准使用
③ You need a license to fish in this river.
= 在这条河里钓鱼要有许可证。
a license = （美式拼法）许可证
英式名词拼 licence。
④ We had lunch at a licensed cafe by the harbour.
= 我们在港口边一家有售酒执照的咖啡馆吃了午饭。
a licensed cafe = 有售酒执照的咖啡馆
⑤ The licensee of the pub was fined for selling drinks after hours.
= 那家酒馆的老板因超时卖酒被罚款。

⑥ Under the licensing laws, pubs could not open on Sunday afternoons.
= 根据售酒法规，酒馆星期天下午不得营业。
licensing laws = （英）售酒法规
⑦ The witness wrote down the license plate of the car.
= 目击者记下了那辆车的车牌。
a license plate = （美）车牌
英式说 number plate。
⑧ The police traced the owner through the license number.
= 警察通过车牌号查到了车主。
a license number = （美）车牌号
⑨ His father was a licensed victualler who ran a pub in Leeds.
= 他父亲是持照卖酒的店主，在利兹开一家酒馆。
a licensed victualler = （英，正式）持照卖酒的店主

licentious
/laɪˈsenʃəs/

lichen
/ˈlaɪkən/

lick
/lɪk/
核心：舔；（火焰、波浪）轻轻掠过；（口语）轻松打败。名词：舔一下；薄薄的一层（漆）。
习语：lick your lips（舔嘴唇；迫不及待）、lick your wounds（舔伤口、养精蓄锐）、lick into shape（把…整顿好）、
a lick of paint（刷一层漆）。名词 licking（口语：一顿痛打；惨败）与副词 lickety-split（美，口语：飞快地）并入本条。
① The dog licked my hand and wagged its tail.
= 那条狗舔了舔我的手，摇起尾巴。
lick somebody's hand = 舔某人的手
② She licked the stamp and stuck it on the envelope.
= 她舔了舔邮票，贴在信封上。
lick a stamp = 舔邮票
③ The children licked their lips when they saw the cake.
= 孩子们看见蛋糕，直舔嘴唇。
lick your lips = 舔嘴唇；迫不及待
④ Flames were licking at the roof of the barn.
= 火舌舔着谷仓的屋顶。
flames lick at something = 火舌舔着…
⑤ After the defeat, the team went home to lick its wounds.
= 输了之后，球队回去舔伤口、养精蓄锐。
lick your wounds = 舔伤口
⑥ The new manager soon licked the office into shape.
= 新经理很快就把办公室整顿好了。
lick into shape = 把…整顿好
⑦ Can I have a lick of your ice cream?
= 我能舔一口你的冰淇淋吗？
a lick = 舔一口
⑧ The kitchen needs a lick of paint before we sell the house.
= 卖房子之前，厨房得刷一层漆。
a lick of paint = 刷一层漆
⑨ Our team took a licking in the final and lost by six goals.
= 我们队在决赛中惨败，输了六个球。
take a licking = （口语）惨败
⑩ The boy ran home lickety-split when he heard the dinner bell.
= 男孩一听见开饭的铃声，飞快地跑回了家。
lickety-split = （美，口语）飞快地

lid
/lɪd/

习语：keep a lid on（控制住、捂住）、take the lid off（揭开…的盖子、曝光）、flip your lid（口语：气疯了）、

① I cannot get the lid off this jar of jam.

④ The book takes the lid off the world of professional football.

⑤ Dad will flip his lid when he sees the dent in the car.

⑥ Store the rice in a lidded jar in a cool place.

⑦ He looked at us with heavy-lidded eyes.

/ˈliːdəʊ/

lie
/laɪ/
核心：两个不同的词，拼法相同。
其一：躺、平卧；（东西）平放着；位于；处于某种状态；（问题、责任）在于。过去式 lay，过去分词 lain，现在分词 lying。
不及物，后面不带宾语 —— 别和 lay（放，laid）弄混。
短语动词：lie down（躺下）、lie back（向后躺、靠着歇息）、lie in（英：睡懒觉）、lie around（随处乱放；懒散地待着）、
lie ahead（在前头等着）、lie behind（是…背后的原因）、lie with（责任、决定权在于）。
习语：lie low（躲起来、不露面）、lie in wait（埋伏着等）。
其二：说谎、撒谎；谎话。过去式、过去分词 lied，现在分词 lying。
常说 tell a lie（撒谎）、a white lie（善意的小谎）、lie detector（测谎仪）。
① She lay on the sofa all afternoon reading a novel.
= 她整个下午躺在沙发上看小说。
lie on the sofa = 躺在沙发上
这里的 lay 是 lie 的过去式。
② He has lain awake every night this week worrying about the exam.
= 这个星期他夜夜躺着睡不着，为考试发愁。
have lain = lie 的完成式
lain 是过去分词，口语里少用。
③ You look pale, so go and lie down for an hour.
= 你脸色苍白，去躺一个小时吧。
lie down = 躺下
④ Lie back in the chair and close your eyes.
= 靠在椅子上，闭上眼睛。
lie back = 向后躺、靠着歇息
⑤ I like to lie in on Sunday mornings.
= 我星期天早上喜欢睡懒觉。
lie in = （英）睡懒觉
⑥ A thick layer of snow lay on the fields.
= 田野上积着厚厚的一层雪。
snow lies on the fields = 田野上积着雪
⑦ The village lies in a valley ten miles north of the town.
= 那个村子位于城北十英里的一个山谷里。
lie in a valley = 位于山谷里
⑧ The factory has lain empty since it closed in 2005.
= 那家工厂自二〇〇五年关门后一直空着。
lie empty = 空着
⑨ The problem lies in the way the money is shared out.
= 问题在于钱的分法。
the problem lies in something = 问题在于…
⑩ Nobody knows what lies ahead for the company.
= 谁也不知道那家公司前头等着的是什么。
lie ahead = 在前头等着
⑪ We wanted to know what lay behind her decision to leave.
= 我们想知道她决定离开的背后原因是什么。
lie behind = 是…背后的原因
⑫ The final decision lies with the head teacher.
= 最后的决定权在校长。
lie with = （责任、决定权）在于
⑬ Don't leave your clothes lying around on the floor.
= 别把衣服扔得满地都是。
lie around = 随处乱放
⑭ The thieves lay low in a cottage until the police stopped looking for them.
= 那伙贼躲在一间小屋里，直到警察不再搜捕。
lie low = 躲起来、不露面
⑮ The cat lay in wait for the mouse behind the cupboard.
= 那只猫埋伏在柜子后面等老鼠。
lie in wait = 埋伏着等
⑯ He lied to his parents about where he had been.
= 他对父母撒了谎，没说实话自己去了哪儿。
lie to somebody = 对某人撒谎
lied 是「说谎」这个词的过去式。
⑰ She lied about her age to get the job.
= 她为了得到那份工作谎报了年龄。
lie about something = 在…上撒谎
⑱ I have never told a lie to my wife.
= 我从没对我妻子撒过谎。
tell a lie = 撒谎
⑲ I told a white lie and said that I loved the present.
= 我撒了个善意的小谎，说我很喜欢那件礼物。
a white lie = 善意的小谎
⑳ The suspect agreed to take a lie detector test.
= 嫌疑人同意接受测谎仪测试。
a lie detector = 测谎仪

Liechtensteiner

liege
/liːdʒ/

lien
/ˈliːən/
核心：（法律）留置权 —— 债务还清之前扣押对方财产的权利。常说 a lien on。
① The bank has a lien on the house until the loan is paid.
= 贷款还清之前，银行对那座房子有留置权。

lieu
/ljuː/
核心：只用于 in lieu (of)（正式）—— 代替、作为…的替代。
① They gave me an extra day's holiday in lieu of payment.
= 他们没付钱，而是多给了我一天假作补偿。
in lieu of = 代替
② I worked on Sunday, so I am taking Tuesday off in lieu.
= 我星期天上了班，所以星期二补休。
in lieu = 作为替代、补休
这一支不带 of：英式常说 time off in lieu。

lieutenant
/lefˈtenənt/
核心：（陆军）中尉；（海军）上尉；（美）警察、消防的副队长；副手、助手。
英式读如 lef-tenant，美式读如 loo-tenant。
军衔与官职并入本条：lieutenant colonel（中校）、lieutenant commander（海军少校）、lieutenant general（中将）、

③ The police lieutenant asked the witnesses to wait outside.
= 那位警察副队长让证人在外面等。
a police lieutenant = （美）警察副队长
④ Her father retired from the army as a lieutenant colonel.
= 她父亲以中校军衔从陆军退役。

⑤ The ship was commanded by a young lieutenant commander.

⑦ The lieutenant governor takes over if the governor falls ill.

life
/laɪf/
核心：生命；一生、寿命；生活；生物（总称）；活力、生气；（口语）无期徒刑。复数 lives。
习语：come to life（活跃起来、有了生气）、bring to life（使生动起来）、for life（终身）、way of life（生活方式）、
lose your life（丧生）、save somebody's life（救某人的命）、the time of your life（玩得痛快极了）、
that's life（生活就是这样）、full of life（充满活力）、a matter of life and death（生死攸关的事）。
搭配：life insurance（人寿保险，英式也说 life cover）、life sentence（无期徒刑）、life cycle（生命周期）、
life form（生命形态）、life force（生命力）、life history（生活史）、life story（生平）、life's work（毕生的事业）、
life coach（人生教练，这一行叫 life coaching）、life skill（生活技能）、life science（生命科学）、
life drawing（人体写生）、life peer（英：终身贵族）、life support（生命维持）、life support machine（生命维持机）、
life raft（救生筏）、life vest（美：救生衣）、life preserver（美：救生用具）；
形容词 life-size（与实物一样大的）、life-saving（救命的）、life-threatening（危及生命的）、life-or-death（生死攸关的）、
life-giving（赋予生命的）、life-affirming（让人感到活着真好的）、life-enhancing（提升生活品质的）。
① The doctors worked all night to save her life.
= 医生们忙了一整夜救她的命。
save somebody's life = 救某人的命
② Three people lost their lives in the fire.
= 三人在那场火灾中丧生。
lose your life = 丧生
lives 是复数。
③ He lived in the same village all his life.
= 他一辈子都住在同一个村子里。
all your life = 一辈子
④ Life in the city is fast and expensive.
= 城里的生活节奏快、花销大。
life in the city = 城里的生活
⑤ Farming is a way of life, not just a job.
= 务农是一种生活方式，不只是一份工作。
a way of life = 生活方式
⑥ Is there life on other planets?
= 别的星球上有生命吗？
life on other planets = 别的星球上的生命
⑦ The children are always full of life in the morning.
= 孩子们早上总是精力充沛。
full of life = 充满活力
⑧ The town comes to life in the evening when the bars open.
= 到了晚上酒吧开门，那座小城就热闹起来。
come to life = 活跃起来
⑨ A good teacher can bring history to life.
= 好老师能把历史讲得活灵活现。
bring to life = 使生动起来
⑩ The accident left him unable to walk for life.
= 那次事故使他终身不能行走。
for life = 终身
⑪ We had the time of our lives at the festival.
= 我们在节庆上玩得痛快极了。
the time of your life = 玩得痛快极了
⑫ I missed the last bus by a minute, but that's life.
= 我差一分钟没赶上末班车，不过生活就是这样。
that's life = 生活就是这样
⑬ The judge gave him life for the murder of his business partner.
= 法官因他谋杀生意伙伴判了他无期徒刑。
get life = （口语）被判无期徒刑
⑭ He is serving a life sentence for murder.
= 他因谋杀正在服无期徒刑。
a life sentence = 无期徒刑
⑮ Getting the medicine to the village was a matter of life and death.
= 把药送到那个村子是生死攸关的事。
a matter of life and death = 生死攸关的事
⑯ He took out life insurance when his first child was born.
= 头一个孩子出生时，他买了人寿保险。
life insurance = 人寿保险
life cover = （英）人寿保险
⑰ The pupils drew the life cycle of a frog.
= 学生们画了青蛙的生命周期。
a life cycle = 生命周期
⑱ Scientists found simple life forms in the ice.
= 科学家在冰里发现了简单的生命形态。
a life form = 生命形态
⑲ In the film, the old tree is the source of the planet's life force.
= 在影片里，那棵古树是那颗星球生命力的源泉。
life force = 生命力
⑳ The book describes the life history of the salmon from egg to adult.
= 那本书描述了鲑鱼从卵到成鱼的生活史。
a life history = 生活史
㉑ The old sailor told us his life story over dinner.
= 那位老水手在饭桌上给我们讲了他的生平。
your life story = 生平
㉒ The dictionary was his life's work.
= 那部词典是他毕生的事业。

㉓ She hired a life coach to help her change careers.
= 她请了一位人生教练帮她转行。

life coaching = 人生教练这一行
㉔ Cooking is a life skill that every child should learn.
