mainstay
/ˈmeɪnsteɪ/
核心：支柱、中坚 —— 某事物赖以维持的最重要的部分。
① Farming is still the mainstay of the country's economy.
= 农业仍是那个国家经济的支柱。
the mainstay of the economy = 经济的支柱
几乎只用比喻义。
② She has been the mainstay of the village choir for forty years.
= 四十年来她一直是村合唱团的中坚。
the mainstay of the choir = 合唱团的中坚
本义是固定主桅的那根大索。

mainstream
/ˈmeɪnstriːm/
核心：the mainstream —— 主流（多数人接受的思想、做法）；主流的。动词：使成为主流；（美）让（特殊需要的孩子）进普通班。
mainstream media（主流媒体）并入本条。
① His ideas are a long way from the mainstream of political thought.
= 他的主张离政治思想的主流很远。
the mainstream = 主流
反义 the fringe（边缘）。
② The band never had a hit in mainstream pop music.
= 那支乐队在主流流行乐坛从没出过热门歌曲。
mainstream music = 主流音乐
③ He says that the mainstream media ignored the story.
= 他说主流媒体对那件事不理不睬。
the mainstream media = 主流媒体
④ The school tries to mainstream children with learning difficulties.
= 那所学校尽量让有学习困难的孩子进普通班上课。
mainstream children = 让孩子进普通班

maintain
/meɪnˈteɪn/
核心：维持、保持；保养、维修；坚称、主张；供养。
① The two countries have maintained good relations for fifty years in spite of several trade disputes.
= 尽管有过几次贸易争端，两国五十年来一直保持着良好关系。
maintain good relations = 保持良好关系
② The roads in the area are badly maintained and full of holes after every winter.
= 那一带的路保养得很差，每年冬天过后到处是坑。
be badly maintained = 保养得很差
③ He has always maintained that he was at home that night.
= 他一直坚称那天晚上他在家。
maintain that… = 坚称…
别人未必相信，他仍这么说。
④ She cannot maintain a family of five on her wages.
= 靠她那点工资养不活一家五口。
maintain a family = 养家
⑤ It is hard to maintain your speed on the steep hills at the end of the race.
= 比赛快结束时那几段陡坡，很难保持速度。
maintain your speed = 保持速度

maintenance
/ˈmeɪntnəns/
核心：保养、维修；维持、保持；（英）（离婚后付给前配偶和子女的）赡养费、抚养费。
① The lift is closed for maintenance until Friday.
= 电梯因检修停用到星期五。
closed for maintenance = 因检修停用
动词是 maintain。
② The maintenance of the old building costs a fortune every year.
= 那座老建筑的保养每年要花一大笔钱。
the maintenance of a building = 建筑的保养
③ He pays maintenance for his two children every month.
= 他每月给两个孩子付抚养费。
pay maintenance = （英）付抚养费
美式说 child support / alimony。

maisonette
/ˌmeɪzəˈnet/
核心：（英）复式公寓 —— 一栋楼里占两层、有自己大门的住宅单元。
① They bought a maisonette above a shop in the high street.
= 他们买了商业街一家店铺楼上的一套复式公寓。
a maisonette = （英）复式公寓
② The maisonette has two bedrooms upstairs and a small garden at the back.
= 那套复式公寓楼上有两间卧室，屋后有个小花园。
the maisonette has… = 那套复式公寓有…
法语「小房子」。

maitre d'
/ˌmeɪtrə ˈdiː/
核心：（餐厅的）领班、总管 —— 负责迎客、排座。maître d'hôtel 的缩略。
① The maitre d' led us to a table by the window.
= 领班把我们带到靠窗的一张桌子。
the maitre d' = 餐厅领班
② She tipped the maitre d' and asked for a quiet corner.
= 她给了领班小费，要了个安静的角落。
tip the maitre d' = 给领班小费
读如 may-truh dee。

maize
/meɪz/
核心：（英）玉米。美式说 corn。
① The farmers grow maize and beans on the hillsides.
= 农民在山坡上种玉米和豆子。
grow maize = 种玉米
甜玉米是 sweetcorn。
② The cattle are fed on maize during the winter.
= 冬天用玉米喂牛。
fed on maize = 用玉米喂
英式的 corn 泛指谷物，所以玉米另叫 maize。

majestic
/məˈdʒestɪk/
核心：雄伟的、壮丽的、威严的。副词 majestically 并入本条。
① The castle stands on a rock with majestic mountains behind it.
= 那座城堡坐落在一块巨岩上，背后是雄伟的群山。
majestic mountains = 雄伟的群山
名词是 majesty。
② The ship moved majestically out of the harbour.
= 那艘船威风凛凛地驶出港口。
move majestically = 威风凛凛地行进
③ An eagle made a majestic sweep over the valley.
= 一只鹰在山谷上空气势雄浑地盘旋而过。
a majestic sweep = 气势雄浑的盘旋

majesty
/ˈmædʒəsti/
核心：雄伟、壮丽、威严；Your / His / Her Majesty（陛下）。
① We stood in silence before the majesty of the mountains.
= 面对群山的雄伟，我们默然伫立。
the majesty of the mountains = 群山的雄伟
② Her Majesty will open the new children's hospital on Tuesday and meet the nurses.
= 女王陛下将于星期二为新的儿童医院揭幕，并会见护士。
Her Majesty = 女王陛下
③ "Dinner is served in the great hall, Your Majesty," said the old servant with a bow.
= 老仆人鞠了一躬，说：“陛下，晚宴已在大厅备好。”
Your Majesty = 陛下（当面称呼）

major
/ˈmeɪdʒə(r)/
核心：主要的、重大的、较大的；（音乐）大调的。名词：（陆军）少校；（美）主修专业、主修某专业的学生。
动词：major in（美：主修）、major on（英：把重点放在）。与 minor 相对。
搭配：major general（少将）、major league（美：职业体育的大联盟；一流的）；
并入本条：majorly（口语：极其）、majorette（行进乐队前挥舞指挥棒的女孩）、major-domo（大管家）。
① The city has a major problem with traffic at the two bridges every morning.
= 那座城市每天早上在两座桥那儿交通问题严重。
a major problem = 重大问题
反义 minor。
② She played a major role in the peace talks that ended the long strike.
= 她在结束那场漫长罢工的和谈中发挥了主要作用。
a major role = 主要作用
③ The cheerful opening piece is written in the key of C major.
= 那首欢快的开场曲是 C 大调的。
C major = C 大调
④ He retired from the army as a major after twenty years of service abroad.
= 在海外服役二十年之后，他以少校军衔从陆军退役。
a major = 少校
⑤ Her major is history, with a minor in French.
= 她主修历史，辅修法语。
your major = （美）主修专业
⑥ He majored in physics at a university in California.
= 他在加利福尼亚的一所大学主修物理。
major in = （美）主修
⑦ The report majors on the cost of the project and says little about safety.
= 那份报告把重点放在项目的成本上，对安全说得很少。
major on = （英）把重点放在
⑧ The major general inspected the troops before the parade.
= 阅兵之前，少将检阅了部队。
a major general = 少将
⑨ He played baseball in the major leagues for twelve years before becoming a coach.
= 他在大联盟打了十二年棒球，后来当了教练。
the major leagues = （美）大联盟
a major league = 大联盟
也作定语：a major-league problem（头等的大问题）。
⑩ I was majorly disappointed by the ending of the film.
= 那部电影的结尾让我大失所望。
majorly = （口语）极其
⑪ A line of majorettes in white boots led the parade.
= 一排穿白靴的女鼓乐队长走在游行队伍前面。
a majorette = 行进乐队的女指挥
⑫ The duke's major-domo met the guests at the door.
= 公爵的大管家在门口迎接客人。
a major-domo = 大管家

majority
/məˈdʒɒrɪti/
核心：大多数、多数（the majority of）；（选举、表决中）超出的票数；（法律）成年、法定年龄。常作定语。
搭配：majority rule（多数决定原则）、majority verdict（多数裁决）、（美）majority leader（多数党领袖）、majority whip（多数党党鞭）。
习语 be in the majority（占多数）、the silent majority（沉默的大多数）。
① The majority of the students at the college live at home and travel in by bus.
= 那所学院的大多数学生住在家里，坐公交车上学。
the majority of = 大多数
后面接复数名词，动词用复数。
② She won the seat by a majority of two thousand votes.
= 她以两千票的多数赢得了那个议席。
a majority of two thousand = 两千票的多数
比对手多出的票数。
③ Women are in the majority in the teaching profession.
= 教师这一行里女性占多数。
be in the majority = 占多数
④ The decision to close the factory was taken by a majority vote of the board.
= 关闭工厂的决定是董事会以多数票通过的。
a majority vote = 多数票
⑤ The silent majority does not agree with the protesters.
= 沉默的大多数并不赞同抗议者。
the silent majority = 沉默的大多数
⑥ After years of struggle, the country moved to majority rule in 1994.
= 经过多年斗争，那个国家在一九九四年转向多数人统治。
majority rule = 多数决定原则、多数人统治
⑦ The jury returned a majority verdict of ten to two.
= 陪审团以十比二作出了多数裁决。
a majority verdict = 多数裁决
⑧ The majority leader promised a vote before the summer break.
= 多数党领袖承诺在夏季休会前表决。
the majority leader = （美）多数党领袖
⑨ The majority whip spent the night counting votes for the bill.
= 多数党党鞭花了一夜清点那项法案的票数。
the majority whip = （美）多数党党鞭
⑩ Under his grandfather's will, he will receive the money when he reaches his majority.
= 按他祖父的遗嘱，他成年后将得到那笔钱。
reach your majority = 成年
这一支是法律用语。

make
/meɪk/
核心：做、制造；使、让（make somebody do，不带 to；make + 宾语 + 形容词）；作出（决定、努力、错误）；挣（钱）；
等于、合计；成为、适合当；赶上、到达、办成（make it）。过去式、过去分词 made。名词：牌子、型号。
常见结构：be made of（由…做成，看得出原料）、be made from（由…制成，原料已变样）、be made into（被做成）、
be made to do（被迫做，被动式要加 to）。
短语动词：make for（朝…走去；有助于）、make towards（朝…走去）、make of（对…怎么看）、make into（把…变成）、
make off（匆匆逃走；make off with = 偷了…逃走）、make out（看清、听清、弄懂；开（支票）；声称；口语：进展）、
make over（把…转让给；彻底改造）、make up（编造；组成；化妆；和好；补足）、make up for（弥补）、
make up to（英，口语：巴结；make it up to = 补偿某人）。
习语：make sure（确保）、make sense（讲得通）、make a difference（有影响）、make do（凑合）、make it（办成、赶到）、
make up your mind（拿定主意）、make fun of（取笑）、make the most of（充分利用）、make way（让路）、
make ends meet（勉强维持生计）、make believe（假装）。
并入本条：made-up（编造的；化了妆的）、made to measure（量身定做的）、made to order（定做的）、
make-believe（假装、幻想）、make-work（美：没事找事的活儿）。
① She made a cake for her daughter's birthday.
= 她为女儿的生日做了一个蛋糕。
make a cake = 做蛋糕
made 是过去式。
② The factory makes parts for cars and lorries.
= 那家工厂生产汽车和卡车的零件。
make parts = 生产零件
名词 maker：制造商。
③ The table is made of solid oak.
= 那张桌子是实心橡木做的。
be made of = 由…做成
看得出原料：木头还是木头。
④ Most of the paper in these books is made from wood grown in northern forests.
= 这些书的纸大多是用北方森林里的木材造的。
be made from = 由…制成
原料已变了样：木头成了纸。
⑤ The old barn has been made into a house.
= 那座旧谷仓被改成了住宅。
make into = 把…变成
⑥ The sad film about the old dog made me cry in the cinema.
= 那部讲老狗的悲伤电影把我在影院里看哭了。
make somebody do something = 使某人做…
主动式不带 to。
⑦ We were made to wait outside for an hour.
= 我们被迫在外面等了一个小时。
be made to do something = 被迫做…
被动式要加 to。
⑧ The news of her son's safe return made her very happy.
= 儿子平安归来的消息让她非常高兴。
make somebody happy = 使某人高兴
make + 宾语 + 形容词。
⑨ I have to make a decision by Friday.
= 我得在星期五之前作出决定。
make a decision = 作决定
make a mistake / an effort / a call 同此。
⑩ She makes forty thousand pounds a year.
= 她一年挣四万英镑。
make money = 挣钱
make a living：谋生。
⑪ Two and two make four, as every child in the first class knows.
= 二加二等于四，一年级的孩子个个都知道。
make four = 等于四
⑫ She will make a good doctor one day.
= 她有朝一日会成为一名好医生。
make a good doctor = 会成为好医生
这一支是「具备当…的素质」。
⑬ We ran all the way but did not make the last train.
= 我们一路跑去，还是没赶上末班火车。
make the train = 赶上火车
口语，同 catch。
⑭ After years of small parts, she finally made it as an actress.
= 演了多年小角色之后，她终于在演艺界闯出了名堂。
make it = 办成、成功
⑮ I am sorry, I cannot make it to the party on Saturday.
= 对不起，星期六的聚会我来不了。
make it to the party = 赶到聚会
⑯ Make sure that you lock the door when you leave.
= 走的时候务必把门锁上。
make sure = 确保
后面接 that 从句或 of。
⑰ What he said about the money does not make sense.
= 他关于那笔钱的说法讲不通。
make sense = 讲得通
make sense of：弄懂。
⑱ A few kind words can make a big difference.
= 几句暖心的话就能起很大的作用。
make a difference = 有影响、起作用
⑲ We have no butter, so we will have to make do with oil.
= 我们没有黄油，只好用油凑合。
make do = 凑合
常说 make do with something。
⑳ I cannot make up my mind which dress to buy.
= 我拿不定主意买哪条裙子。
make up your mind = 拿定主意
㉑ The other children made fun of his accent.
= 别的孩子取笑他的口音。
make fun of = 取笑
多含恶意。
㉒ We made the most of the sunshine and had lunch in the garden.
= 我们趁着阳光好，在花园里吃了午饭。
make the most of = 充分利用
㉓ The crowd made way for the ambulance.
= 人群给救护车让了路。
make way = 让路
常说 make way for。
㉔ With three children and one wage, they struggle to make ends meet.
= 三个孩子、一份工资，他们勉强维持生计。
make ends meet = 勉强维持生计
让收入和支出两「头」接上。
㉕ The children made believe that the garden shed was a castle.
= 孩子们假装花园的棚屋是一座城堡。
make believe = 假装
㉖ When the rain started, we made for the nearest shelter.
= 雨一下，我们就朝最近的避雨处走去。
make for = 朝…走去
㉗ Good lighting makes for a pleasant place to work.
= 光线好，工作的地方就舒服。
make for = 有助于
㉘ He got up from the table and made towards the door.
= 他从桌边站起来，朝门口走去。
make towards = 朝…走去
㉙ What do you make of the new manager and her plans for the office?
= 你觉得新来的经理和她对办公室的那些打算怎么样？
make of = 对…怎么看
㉚ The thieves made off before the police arrived.
= 警察赶到之前，那伙贼逃走了。
make off = 匆匆逃走
多说做了坏事之后。
㉛ Someone made off with my bicycle while I was in the shop.
= 我在店里的时候，有人把我的自行车偷走了。
make off with = 偷了…逃走
㉜ I could just make out a figure in the fog.
= 我在雾里勉强看出一个人影。
make out = 看清、听清
常与 can / could 连用。
㉝ He keeps changing his story, and I cannot make out what he wants.
= 他的说法变来变去，我弄不懂他想要什么。
make out what… = 弄懂…
㉞ Please make the cheque out to the school.
= 支票抬头请写学校。
make out a cheque = 开支票
㉟ He is not as rich as he makes out.
= 他没有他自称的那么有钱。
make out = 声称、装作
㊱ He made the house over to his son before he died.
= 他去世前把房子过户给了儿子。
make over = 把…转让给
另一义「彻底改造」见 makeover。
㊲ She made up an excuse about missing the bus.
= 她编了个没赶上公交车的借口。
make up = 编造
形容词 made-up。
㊳ Women make up sixty per cent of the students.
= 女生占学生的六成。
make up = 组成、占
㊴ She makes herself up carefully before she goes on stage.
= 她上台前仔细化妆。
make yourself up = 化妆
㊵ The two sisters had a quarrel over the car but soon made up.
= 姐妹俩为了车吵了一架，不过很快就和好了。
make up = 和好
kiss and make up：亲一下，和好。
㊶ Nothing can make up for the years he spent in prison.
= 他在牢里度过的那些年，什么也弥补不了。
make up for = 弥补
make up for lost time：把耽误的时间补回来。
㊷ I am sorry I forgot your birthday; I will make it up to you.
= 对不起我忘了你的生日，我会补偿你的。
make it up to somebody = 补偿某人
㊸ He is always making up to the boss in the hope of a pay rise.
= 他老是巴结老板，指望加薪。
make up to = （英，口语）巴结
㊹ What make of car does she drive?
= 她开的是什么牌子的车？
a make of car = 汽车的牌子
这一支是名词。
㊺ The whole story about the lost dog was made-up.
= 丢狗的那一整套说法都是编的。
made-up = 编造的
也指「化了妆的」。
㊻ He wears made to measure suits from a tailor in London.
= 他穿伦敦一位裁缝量身定做的西装。
made to measure = 量身定做的
㊼ The kitchen cupboards were made to order by a local carpenter.
= 厨房的柜子是当地一位木匠定做的。
made to order = 定做的
㊽ The children live in a world of make-believe.
= 孩子们生活在幻想的世界里。
make-believe = 假装、幻想
㊾ The new forms are just make-work for the office staff.
= 那些新表格纯粹是给办公室人员没事找事。
make-work = （美）没事找事的活儿

makeover
/ˈmeɪkəʊvə(r)/
核心：改头换面 —— 给人换发型、妆容、穿着的全面改造；（房屋、形象的）彻底翻新。
① The magazine gave three readers a free makeover.
= 那本杂志给三位读者做了免费的形象改造。
a makeover = 形象改造
② The old hotel has had a complete makeover and reopened last month.
= 那家老酒店彻底翻新了，上个月重新开业。
a complete makeover = 彻底翻新
来自 make over（彻底改造）。

maker
/ˈmeɪkə(r)/
核心：制造者、制造商；（作后一成分）做…的人或机器；the Maker / your Maker（造物主、上帝）。
① The company is the largest maker of washing machines in Europe.
= 那家公司是欧洲最大的洗衣机制造商。
a maker of something = …的制造商
② She bought a coffee maker for the office.
= 她给办公室买了一台咖啡机。
a coffee maker = 咖啡机
decision-maker、film-maker 同此构词。
③ The old sailor said that he was ready to meet his Maker.
= 那位老水手说，他已准备好去见上帝了。
meet your Maker = 去见上帝（去世）
带点幽默的说法。

makeshift
/ˈmeɪkʃɪft/
核心：临时凑合的、权宜的 —— 没有合适的东西，暂时拿别的顶替。
① The refugees slept in makeshift tents made of plastic sheets.
= 难民们睡在用塑料布搭的临时帐篷里。
makeshift tents = 临时帐篷
② We used a door as a makeshift table for the party.
= 我们拿一扇门当聚会的临时桌子。
a makeshift table = 临时凑合的桌子
来自 make shift（设法凑合）。

makeweight
/ˈmeɪkweɪt/
核心：凑数的人或物 —— 本身不重要，只为补足数量；本义是添秤的小东西。
① He was included in the team as a makeweight when two players fell ill.
= 两名球员病倒了，他被拉进队里凑数。
a makeweight = 凑数的人
② The last chapter is a mere makeweight and adds nothing to the book.
= 最后一章纯属凑数，对那本书毫无增益。
a mere makeweight = 纯属凑数的东西

making
/ˈmeɪkɪŋ/
核心：制作、形成（的过程）。
习语：in the making（正在形成中的）、of your own making（自己造成的）、be the making of（使…成才）、
have the makings of（有成为…的素质）。
① The film shows the making of a violin from start to finish.
= 那部影片从头到尾展示了一把小提琴的制作过程。
the making of something = …的制作
② The crowd in the square knew that they were watching history in the making.
= 广场上的人群知道，他们正在见证历史的创造。
in the making = 正在形成中的
③ Most of the problems of the company are of its own making, not the result of bad luck.
= 那家公司的问题大多是它自己造成的，不是运气不好。
of your own making = 自己造成的
④ He was a lazy boy, but two years in the army were the making of him.
= 他原是个懒孩子，可在军队的两年使他成了才。
be the making of somebody = 使某人成才
⑤ At fourteen, she already has the makings of a great tennis player.
= 才十四岁，她已经有了成为伟大网球选手的素质。
have the makings of = 有成为…的素质
这一支用复数 makings。

maladjusted
/ˌmæləˈdʒʌstɪd/
核心：（尤指儿童）适应不良的 —— 有情绪、行为问题，难以和人相处。名词 maladjustment 并入本条。
① The school takes maladjusted children who have been excluded from other classes.
= 那所学校接收被别的班开除的适应不良儿童。
maladjusted children = 适应不良的儿童
② The report links the boy's maladjustment to years of trouble at home.
= 那份报告把男孩的适应不良归因于家里多年的不安宁。
maladjustment = 适应不良
前缀 mal- 表示「坏、不良」。

maladministration
/ˌmælədˌmɪnɪˈstreɪʃən/
核心：（正式）管理不善、行政失当。
① The inquiry found the council guilty of maladministration in handling the housing fund.
= 调查认定市政会在管理住房基金上行政失当。
guilty of maladministration = 行政失当
② Years of maladministration left the hospital with huge debts.
= 多年管理不善让那家医院负债累累。
years of maladministration = 多年的管理不善

maladroit
/ˌmæləˈdrɔɪt/
核心：（正式）笨拙的、不机敏的 —— 尤指处事、说话不得体。
① The minister's maladroit handling of the strike made the workers even angrier.
= 部长处理罢工的手法笨拙，让工人更加愤怒。
maladroit handling = 笨拙的处理
② He is clever with machines but maladroit in dealing with people.
= 他摆弄机器很灵，和人打交道却很笨拙。
be maladroit in doing something = 做…很笨拙
adroit（灵巧的）的反义。

malady
/ˈmælədi/
核心：（正式或旧）疾病；（比喻）弊病、顽疾。
① The old doctor could find no cure for her strange malady.
= 那位老医生找不到治她那种怪病的办法。
a strange malady = 怪病
② Corruption is the worst malady of the country's political system.
= 腐败是那个国家政治体制最严重的顽疾。
the malady of the system = 体制的弊病
这一支是比喻，今天更常见。

Malagasy
/ˌmæləˈɡæsi/
核心：马达加斯加人；马达加斯加语；马达加斯加的。复数不变或加 -s。
① Most Malagasy live by growing rice in the highlands.
= 大多数马达加斯加人靠在高原上种稻为生。
the Malagasy = 马达加斯加人
② The children speak Malagasy at home and French at school.
= 孩子们在家说马达加斯加语，在学校说法语。
speak Malagasy = 说马达加斯加语
③ We listened to Malagasy music played on a bamboo harp.
= 我们听了用竹制竖琴演奏的马达加斯加音乐。
Malagasy music = 马达加斯加音乐

malaise
/məˈleɪz/
核心：（正式）说不清的不舒服、不适感；（社会、组织里）说不清道不明的不景气、萎靡。
① She complained of a general malaise and a slight fever.
= 她说自己浑身不舒服，还有点低烧。
a general malaise = 浑身不舒服
② The strike is a sign of the deeper malaise in the industry.
= 那场罢工是该行业更深层萎靡的征兆。
the malaise in the industry = 行业的萎靡
法语借词，读如 ma-layz。

malapropism
/ˈmæləprɒpɪzəm/
核心：近音词误用 —— 把一个词说成读音相近却意思全错的词，引人发笑。
① He said that the flowers were in full glume, a malapropism that made everyone laugh.
= 他说花正开得「茂剩」，这个近音错字把大家都逗笑了。
a malapropism = 近音词误用
② The comedian builds his act on malapropisms and bad puns.
= 那位喜剧演员的整套表演靠的是说错近音词和蹩脚的双关。
build an act on malapropisms = 靠说错近音词做表演
得名于十八世纪喜剧里老说错词的 Mrs Malaprop。

malaria
/məˈleəriə/
核心：疟疾 —— 由蚊子传播的热带病，发冷发热反复发作。形容词 malarial 并入本条。
① He caught malaria while working on a bridge project in West Africa.
= 他在西非做一个桥梁项目时得了疟疾。
catch malaria = 得疟疾
② Sleeping under a net is the simplest protection against malaria.
= 睡在蚊帐里是预防疟疾最简单的办法。
protection against malaria = 预防疟疾
③ The village stands beside a malarial swamp, and half the children fall ill every rainy season.
= 那个村子紧挨着一片疟疾流行的沼泽，每到雨季有一半孩子病倒。
a malarial swamp = 疟疾流行的沼泽
意大利语「坏空气」：旧时以为是瘴气所致。

malarkey
/məˈlɑːki/
核心：（口语）胡说、废话、鬼话。
① Do not listen to all that malarkey about easy money from people who sell courses online.
= 别听那些在网上卖课的人说的轻松来钱的鬼话。
all that malarkey = 那些鬼话
② He told me some malarkey about his car breaking down again.
= 他又跟我扯了一通车坏了的瞎话。
some malarkey = 一通瞎话
有点老派，带爱尔兰裔美国人的味道。

Malawian
/məˈlɑːwiən/
核心：马拉维的；马拉维人。
① The Malawian lake is so long that it has its own fishing villages and ferries.
= 马拉维的那座湖很长，湖上有自己的渔村和渡船。
the Malawian lake = 马拉维的湖
国名是 Malawi，在非洲东南部。
② Many Malawians grow maize and tobacco on small farms.
= 许多马拉维人在小农场上种玉米和烟草。
a Malawian = 马拉维人

Malay
/məˈleɪ/

the Malays = 马来人

③ We ate a Malay curry made with coconut milk.

Malayalam
/ˌmæləˈjɑːləm/
核心：马拉雅拉姆语 —— 印度西南部喀拉拉邦的语言。
① Her parents speak Malayalam at home and English at work.
= 她父母在家说马拉雅拉姆语，上班说英语。

in Malayalam = 用马拉雅拉姆语

Malaysian
/məˈleɪziən/
核心：马来西亚的；马来西亚人。
① The Malaysian capital is famous for its twin towers and its busy night markets.
= 马来西亚的首都以双子塔和热闹的夜市闻名。
the Malaysian capital = 马来西亚首都
② Many Malaysians speak three or four languages and switch between them in one sentence.
= 许多马来西亚人会说三四种语言，一句话里就能换来换去。
a Malaysian = 马来西亚人

malcontent

a few malcontents = 几个心怀不满的人

= 经理把麻烦归咎于一小撮不满分子。
a group of malcontents = 一撮不满分子

Maldivian
/mɔːlˈdɪviən/

a Maldivian = 马尔代夫人

male
/meɪl/
核心：男性的、雄性的；男性、雄性动物。与 female 相对。名词 maleness（男性特质）并入本条；
搭配 male chauvinist（大男子主义者）、male menopause（男性更年期）、male-dominated（男性主导的）。
① The male bird has bright red feathers on its head.
= 那种鸟雄的头上有鲜红的羽毛。
the male bird = 雄鸟
② Most of the nurses on the ward are female, but two are male.
= 那个病房的护士大多是女的，但有两个是男的。
be male = 是男性
③ The males fight each other for the best place on the beach.
= 雄性为争夺海滩上最好的位置互相打斗。
the males = 雄性
④ Engineering is still a male-dominated profession.
= 工程师仍是男性主导的职业。
male-dominated = 男性主导的
⑤ Her boss is a male chauvinist who thinks women cannot lead a team.
= 她的上司是个大男子主义者，觉得女人带不了团队。
a male chauvinist = 大男子主义者
⑥ He bought a sports car at fifty, and his wife blamed the male menopause.
= 他五十岁时买了辆跑车，他妻子说这是男性更年期闹的。
the male menopause = 男性更年期
多半是玩笑话。
⑦ The film questions old ideas of maleness.
= 那部电影对关于男性特质的旧观念提出了质疑。
maleness = 男性特质

malefactor
/ˈmælɪfæktə(r)/
核心：（正式，旧）作恶的人、罪犯。
① The malefactors were caught and brought before the judge.
= 那些作恶的人被抓住，带到了法官面前。
a malefactor = 作恶的人
② In the old tale, the hero hunts down the malefactor who burned the village.
= 在那个古老的故事里，英雄追捕烧毁村庄的恶人。
hunt down the malefactor = 追捕恶人
反义 benefactor（恩人）。

malevolent
/məˈlevələnt/
核心：（正式）恶意的、心怀恶意的。名词 malevolence 与副词 malevolently 并入本条。
① She gave him a malevolent look across the table.
= 她隔着桌子恶狠狠地看了他一眼。
a malevolent look = 恶狠狠的眼神
② The villagers believed that a malevolent spirit lived in the old well.
= 村民们相信那口老井里住着一个恶灵。
a malevolent spirit = 恶灵
③ There was real malevolence in his voice when he spoke of his brother.
= 他说起他哥哥时，声音里带着真切的恶意。
malevolence = 恶意
④ The cat stared malevolently at the new puppy.
= 那只猫恶狠狠地盯着新来的小狗。
stare malevolently = 恶狠狠地盯着
反义 benevolent（仁慈的）。

malfeasance
/ˌmælˈfiːzəns/
核心：（法律，正式）渎职、不法行为 —— 尤指官员的。
① The mayor was removed from office for malfeasance.
= 那位市长因渎职被免职。
removed for malfeasance = 因渎职被免职
② The report found no evidence of financial malfeasance at the charity.
= 那份报告没有发现那家慈善机构有财务上的不法行为。
financial malfeasance = 财务上的不法行为

malformation
/ˌmælfɔːˈmeɪʃən/
核心：畸形（的状况或部位）。形容词 malformed（畸形的）并入本条。
① The baby was born with a malformation of the heart.
= 那个婴儿生下来心脏就有畸形。
a malformation of the heart = 心脏畸形
② The drug was banned after it caused malformations in unborn children.
= 那种药导致胎儿畸形后被禁用了。
cause malformations = 导致畸形
③ The vet found that the kitten had a malformed leg.
= 兽医发现那只小猫有一条腿畸形。
a malformed leg = 畸形的腿

malfunction
/ˌmælˈfʌŋkʃən/
核心：（机器、器官）发生故障、失灵；名词：故障。
① The plane's left engine malfunctioned shortly after it took off.
= 飞机起飞后不久，左发动机发生了故障。
the engine malfunctions = 发动机发生故障
② A malfunction in the alarm system let the thieves walk in.
= 警报系统出了故障，让窃贼大摇大摆地走了进去。
a malfunction in the system = 系统故障
比 break down 正式，多见于技术报告。

Malian
/ˈmɑːliən/

malice
/ˈmælɪs/
核心：恶意、害人之心。习语 bear somebody no malice（对某人不怀恶意）；法律用语 with malice aforethought（蓄意）。
① She spread the story about her neighbour's debts out of pure malice.
= 她散布邻居欠债的说法，纯粹出于恶意。
out of malice = 出于恶意
② I bear him no malice for what he said about me at the meeting last year.
= 他去年在会上那样说我，我并不记恨他。
bear somebody no malice = 对某人不怀恶意
③ The court decided that he had bought the knife and acted with malice aforethought.
= 法庭裁定他事先买了刀，是蓄意为之。
with malice aforethought = 蓄意

malicious
/məˈlɪʃəs/
核心：恶意的、存心害人的。副词 maliciously 并入本条。
① Someone has been spreading malicious gossip about the new teacher.
= 有人一直在散布关于新老师的恶意流言。
malicious gossip = 恶意的流言
② He was charged with causing malicious damage to a car.
= 他被控恶意损坏汽车。
malicious damage = 恶意损坏
③ The fire was started maliciously, not by accident.
= 那场火是有人蓄意放的，不是意外。
maliciously = 恶意地、蓄意地

malign
/məˈlaɪn/
核心：（正式）诽谤、中伤 —— 说某人的坏话，多不属实；形容词：有害的、恶意的。
① She feels that she has been unfairly maligned by the newspapers.
= 她觉得自己被报纸不公正地中伤了。
be maligned = 被中伤
② The much-maligned bus service is in fact cheap and on time.
= 那条饱受诟病的公交线路其实又便宜又准点。
much-maligned = 饱受诟病的
常用来替被骂得太狠的人或物说句公道话。
③ He blamed his failure on the malign influence of his older brother.
= 他把自己的失败归咎于哥哥的不良影响。
a malign influence = 不良影响
反义 benign（良性的、和善的）。

malignant
/məˈlɪɡnənt/
核心：（肿瘤）恶性的；（正式）恶毒的、怀有恶意的。名词 malignancy（恶性；恶性肿瘤）并入本条。
① After a week of waiting, the tests showed that the lump was not malignant.
= 等了一个星期，检查结果显示那个肿块不是恶性的。
a malignant lump = 恶性肿块
② She gave her rival a malignant stare across the room.
= 她隔着屋子恶毒地瞪了对手一眼。
a malignant stare = 恶毒的目光
③ The surgeon removed the malignancy from her lung before it could spread to the liver.
= 外科医生在她肺部的恶性肿瘤扩散到肝脏之前把它切除了。
a malignancy = 恶性肿瘤
与 benign（良性的）相对。
④ Tests showed that the growth was non-malignant, and the surgeon sent her home.
= 检查显示那个肿块不是恶性的，外科医生就让她回家了。
non-malignant = 非恶性的

malinger
/məˈlɪŋɡə(r)/
核心：装病（以逃避工作、责任）—— 多用进行时。名词 malingerer（装病的人）并入本条。
① The sergeant thought that the soldier was malingering to avoid the long march.
= 中士认为那个士兵是在装病，好逃掉长途行军。
be malingering = 在装病
② The doctor can usually tell a real patient from a malingerer.
= 医生通常分得出真病人和装病的人。
a malingerer = 装病的人
带责备的意味。

mall
/mɔːl/

① We spent Saturday afternoon at the mall buying clothes for the children.
= 星期六下午我们在商场给孩子们买衣服。

② A new shopping mall is being built on the edge of town.
= 城边正在建一座新的购物中心。
a shopping mall = 购物中心
③ As a teenager, she was a mall rat who knew every shop by heart.

mallard
/ˈmælɑːd/
核心：绿头鸭 —— 最常见的野鸭，雄的头部呈亮绿色。复数 mallards 或不变。
① A pair of mallards swam across the pond with six ducklings behind them.
= 一对绿头鸭带着身后的六只小鸭游过池塘。
a pair of mallards = 一对绿头鸭
② The male mallard has a shiny green head and a white ring around its neck.
= 雄绿头鸭有闪亮的绿脑袋和一圈白色的颈环。
the male mallard = 雄绿头鸭
家鸭大多是它驯化来的。

malleable
/ˈmæliəbəl/
核心：（金属）可锻的、有延展性的；（人、想法）易受影响的、可塑的。名词 malleability 并入本条。
① Gold is so malleable that it can be beaten into very thin sheets.
= 金的延展性极好，能捶成极薄的金箔。
malleable gold = 可锻的金
② Young children have malleable minds and learn new habits quickly.
= 幼儿的头脑可塑性强，新习惯学得快。
malleable minds = 可塑的头脑
③ The malleability of copper makes it ideal for pipes and wire.
= 铜的延展性好，最适合做管子和电线。
malleability = 延展性、可塑性
拉丁语 malleus 是「锤子」。

mallet
/ˈmælɪt/
核心：木槌、橡皮锤 —— 头部较大的锤子；（槌球、马球的）球槌。
① He knocked the tent pegs into the ground with a wooden mallet.
= 他用木槌把帐篷桩敲进地里。
a wooden mallet = 木槌
② She swung her croquet mallet and sent the ball through the hoop.
= 她挥动槌球球槌，把球打过了铁环。
a croquet mallet = 槌球球槌

mallow
/ˈmæləʊ/
核心：锦葵 —— 开粉色、紫色或白色花的植物，茎叶上有细毛。
① Pink mallow grows wild along the edge of the field.
= 粉色的锦葵在田边野生野长。
pink mallow = 粉色锦葵
② The bees were busy on the tall mallows by the garden gate.
= 花园门边那几株高高的锦葵上，蜜蜂正忙个不停。
tall mallows = 高高的锦葵
棉花糖 marshmallow 原是用沼泽锦葵的根做的。

malnutrition
/ˌmælnjuːˈtrɪʃən/
核心：营养不良。形容词 malnourished（营养不良的）并入本条。
① Thousands of children in the region are suffering from malnutrition.
= 那个地区成千上万的儿童营养不良。
suffer from malnutrition = 营养不良
② The stray dog was thin and badly malnourished when we found it.
= 我们发现那条流浪狗时，它瘦骨嶙峋，严重营养不良。
badly malnourished = 严重营养不良
③ Malnutrition can be caused by eating the wrong food as well as by eating too little.
= 营养不良既可能是吃得太少，也可能是吃得不对。
malnutrition is caused by = 营养不良由…引起

malodorous
/ˌmælˈəʊdərəs/
核心：（正式）有恶臭的、难闻的。
① The malodorous river ran black between the factories.
= 那条臭气熏天的河在工厂之间流着黑水。
a malodorous river = 臭气熏天的河
② He pulled a malodorous pair of socks from the bottom of his sports bag.
= 他从运动包底下拽出一双臭烘烘的袜子。
malodorous socks = 臭烘烘的袜子
常带点幽默的文雅说法。

malpractice
/mælˈpræktɪs/
核心：（医生、律师等的）渎职、医疗事故、失职行为。
① The family sued the surgeon for medical malpractice.
= 那家人以医疗事故为由起诉了那位外科医生。
medical malpractice = 医疗事故
② The lawyer was found guilty of malpractice and lost his licence.
= 那位律师被认定失职，丢了执照。
guilty of malpractice = 被认定失职

malt
/mɔːlt/
核心：麦芽 —— 发芽后烘干的大麦，用来酿啤酒、威士忌；麦芽威士忌；（美）麦乳精饮料。形容词 malted（加麦芽的）并入本条。
搭配：malt whisky（麦芽威士忌）、malt vinegar（麦芽醋）、malted milk（麦乳精）。
① The beer is made from malt, hops and water from the local spring.
= 那种啤酒是用麦芽、啤酒花和当地的泉水酿的。
made from malt = 用麦芽酿的
② He poured himself a glass of twelve-year-old malt.
= 他给自己倒了一杯十二年的麦芽威士忌。
a glass of malt = 一杯麦芽威士忌
③ The island is famous for its smoky malt whisky.
= 那座岛以带烟熏味的麦芽威士忌闻名。
malt whisky = 麦芽威士忌
④ Sprinkle salt and malt vinegar on the chips.
= 往炸薯条上撒盐、洒麦芽醋。
malt vinegar = 麦芽醋
英国吃炸鱼薯条的标配。
⑤ She made the children a hot drink of malted milk before bed.
= 睡前她给孩子们冲了一杯热麦乳精。
malted milk = 麦乳精
⑥ The loaf is made with malted flour and has a sweet, nutty taste.
= 那条面包是用加麦芽的面粉做的，有甜甜的坚果味。
malted flour = 加麦芽的面粉
⑦ The men on the corner were drinking cans of cheap malt liquor.
= 街角那几个男人在喝便宜的罐装麦芽酒。
malt liquor = （美）麦芽酒
比普通啤酒度数高。

Maltese
/ˌmɔːlˈtiːz/
核心：马耳他的；马耳他人（复数不变）；马耳他语。Maltese cross（马耳他十字：四臂末端呈 V 形的十字）并入本条。
① The Maltese capital is a small walled city above the harbour.
= 马耳他的首都是港口上方一座有城墙的小城。
the Maltese capital = 马耳他首都
② Most Maltese speak English as well as their own language.
= 大多数马耳他人除了本族语言还会说英语。
the Maltese = 马耳他人
③ The road signs on the island are written in Maltese and English.
= 岛上的路牌用马耳他语和英语书写。
in Maltese = 用马耳他语
④ The firefighters wear a badge in the shape of a Maltese cross.
= 那些消防员佩戴马耳他十字形的徽章。
a Maltese cross = 马耳他十字

Malthusian
/mælˈθjuːziən/
核心：马尔萨斯学说的 —— 认为人口增长总会超过粮食供给，终将导致饥荒。
① The writer gives a Malthusian warning that the world cannot feed ten billion people.
= 那位作者发出马尔萨斯式的警告：世界养不活一百亿人。
a Malthusian warning = 马尔萨斯式的警告
② Better farming has so far proved the Malthusian view wrong.
= 迄今为止，农业的进步证明马尔萨斯的看法是错的。
the Malthusian view = 马尔萨斯的看法
得名于十八世纪英国经济学家 Malthus。

maltreat
/ˌmælˈtriːt/
核心：虐待。名词 maltreatment 并入本条。
① The court heard that the dogs had been starved and maltreated.
= 法庭获悉，那几条狗曾挨饿受虐。
be maltreated = 受虐待
② The charity cares for children who have been maltreated at home.
= 那家慈善机构照顾在家里受过虐待的儿童。
children who have been maltreated = 受过虐待的儿童
③ Two guards were dismissed for the maltreatment of prisoners.
= 两名看守因虐待囚犯被开除。
the maltreatment of somebody = 虐待某人
同 ill-treat、mistreat。

malware
/ˈmælweə(r)/
核心：恶意软件 —— 病毒、木马等蓄意损害电脑或窃取数据的程序。
① The email contained malware that copied all the passwords on the computer.
= 那封邮件里藏着恶意软件，把电脑上的密码全复制走了。
contain malware = 含有恶意软件
② Keep your software up to date to protect the phone against malware.
= 软件要及时更新，以防手机感染恶意软件。
protect against malware = 防范恶意软件
malicious（恶意的）加 software 的拼合词。

mam
/mæm/
核心：（英，口语，方言）妈、妈妈 —— 英格兰北部、威尔士、爱尔兰的说法。
① My mam makes the best apple pie in the street.
= 我妈做的苹果派是整条街最好吃的。
my mam = （方言）我妈
② "Mam, can I go out to play after tea?" asked the boy.
= 男孩问：“妈，吃完晚饭我能出去玩吗？”
Mam = 妈（称呼）
英式通用的说法是 mum，美式是 mom。

mama
/məˈmɑː/
核心：（旧或美，口语）妈妈；也拼 mamma。
① The baby held out her arms and cried for her mama.
= 那个婴儿伸出胳膊，哭着要妈妈。
her mama = 她的妈妈
② "Mama, look at the big ship!" shouted the little girl.
= 小女孩喊道：“妈妈，看那条大船！”
Mama = 妈妈（称呼）
③ He is thirty and still a mama’s boy who phones home twice a day.
= 他三十岁了，还是个离不开妈的男人，一天往家打两次电话。
a mama’s boy = （美，口语）离不开妈的男孩
英式说 mummy's boy。

mamba
/ˈmæmbə/
核心：曼巴蛇 —— 非洲的剧毒蛇，行动极快，有黑曼巴、绿曼巴等。
① A black mamba can move faster than a man can run.
= 黑曼巴蛇游走起来比人跑得还快。
a black mamba = 黑曼巴蛇
② The guide warned us that a green mamba was hiding in the tree above the path.
= 向导提醒我们，小路上方的树上藏着一条绿曼巴蛇。
a green mamba = 绿曼巴蛇

mambo
/ˈmæmbəʊ/
核心：曼波舞 —— 源自古巴的节奏强烈的舞蹈；曼波舞曲。
① The couple danced the mambo in the middle of the crowded floor.
= 那对舞伴在拥挤的舞池中央跳起了曼波。
dance the mambo = 跳曼波舞
② The band played a mambo, and the whole room began to move.
= 乐队奏起一支曼波舞曲，满屋的人都动了起来。
play a mambo = 奏曼波舞曲

mammal
/ˈmæməl/
核心：哺乳动物。形容词 mammalian 并入本条。
① Whales and bats are mammals, though one swims and the other flies.
= 鲸和蝙蝠都是哺乳动物，尽管一个游、一个飞。
a mammal = 哺乳动物
② The blue whale is the largest mammal that has ever lived.
= 蓝鲸是有史以来最大的哺乳动物。
the largest mammal = 最大的哺乳动物
③ The mammalian brain is larger for its body size than the brain of a reptile.
= 按身体比例，哺乳动物的脑比爬行动物的大。
the mammalian brain = 哺乳动物的脑
拉丁语 mamma 是「乳房」。

mammary
/ˈmæməri/
核心：（解剖）乳房的、乳腺的 —— 只用在名词前。
① The mammary glands produce milk after the young are born.
= 幼崽出生后，乳腺开始分泌乳汁。
the mammary glands = 乳腺
② The vet found a small mammary tumour on the old dog.
= 兽医在那条老狗身上发现了一个小小的乳腺肿瘤。
a mammary tumour = 乳腺肿瘤

mammogram
/ˈmæməɡræm/
核心：乳房 X 光片、乳腺钼靶检查。名词 mammography（乳房 X 光检查术）并入本条。
① Women over fifty are invited to have a mammogram every three years.
= 五十岁以上的妇女每三年被邀请做一次乳腺钼靶检查。
have a mammogram = 做乳腺钼靶检查
② The mammogram showed a small shadow that needed further tests.
= 那张乳房 X 光片上有一小块阴影，需要进一步检查。
the mammogram shows = X 光片显示
③ Mammography can find a growth long before it can be felt.
= 乳房 X 光检查能在摸得到之前很久就发现肿物。
mammography = 乳房 X 光检查

Mammon
/ˈmæmən/
核心：（贬）财神、钱财 —— 把金钱当神来拜、视为罪恶之源时的说法。出自《圣经》。
① The preacher accused the bankers of the city of worshipping Mammon and forgetting the poor.
= 布道者指责那座城市的银行家拜金而忘了穷人。
worship Mammon = 拜金
② The old priest reminded the rich merchant that nobody can serve both God and Mammon.
= 老神父提醒那位富商，谁也不能既侍奉上帝又侍奉钱财。
serve Mammon = 侍奉钱财
这句出自《新约》，已成谚语。

mammoth
/ˈmæməθ/
核心：猛犸、长毛象 —— 冰河时期已灭绝的长毛大象；形容词：巨大的、庞大的。
① The frozen body of a baby mammoth was found in the ice of Siberia.
= 人们在西伯利亚的冰层里发现了一具冰冻的幼年猛犸象遗体。
a mammoth = 猛犸象
② Clearing the forest of landmines is a mammoth task.
= 把那片森林里的地雷清干净是一项浩大的工程。
a mammoth task = 浩大的工程
这一支作形容词，更常见。

man
/mæn/
核心：男人、成年男子；人、人类（旧式的泛指，今天多改说 people、humans）；（复数 men）士兵、工人、手下；
（口语）老兄（称呼）、丈夫或男友；棋子。复数 men。动词：给…配备人手、操纵、值守。感叹（美，口语）：天哪。
习语：the man in the street（普通人、老百姓）、to a man（无一例外、全体）、man to man（男人对男人、坦率地）、
be your own man（自己作主、不受人摆布）、be man enough to（有胆量做）、a man of his word（说话算数的人）、
the man of the house（一家之主）。短语动词 man up（口语：拿出男子汉的样子）。
复合词：man-made（人造的）、man-hour（工时）、man-sized（大号的、成人份的）、man-eater（吃人的野兽；谑：专吃男人的女人）、
man-eating（吃人的）、man-of-war（旧：军舰）、man of letters（文人）、man Friday（得力的男助手）、
man cave（口语：男人的私人天地）、man bag（男用挎包）、man flu（谑：男人的小感冒大惊小怪）、man boobs（口语：男人发福的胸）。
形容词 manned（有人驾驶的、有人值守的）并入本条；man management（英：对人的管理）也在这里。
① A tall man in a grey coat was waiting at the door.
= 一个穿灰大衣的高个男人等在门口。
a man = 男人
与 woman 相对；复数 men。
② The two men shook hands and sat down.
= 那两个男人握了握手，坐了下来。
men = man 的复数
③ Man has lived in this valley for ten thousand years.
= 人类在这条山谷里生活了一万年。
man = 人类
旧式的泛指用法，不加冠词；今天多说 humans 或 people。
④ The officer led his men across the river at night.
= 那位军官夜里带着手下的士兵渡了河。
his men = 他手下的士兵
军官、工头说自己带的人。
⑤ Hey, man, can you help me push this car?
= 嘿，老兄，能帮我推一下这辆车吗？
man = （口语）老兄
⑥ Man, that was a long day!
= 天哪，这一天可真长！
Man! = （美，口语）天哪
⑦ She has gone to the cinema with her new man.
= 她和新男友看电影去了。
her man = （口语）她的男友、丈夫
⑧ He moved one of his men forward and took my bishop.
= 他把一枚棋子往前一挪，吃了我的象。
a man = 棋子
⑨ Volunteers man the telephones at the centre day and night.
= 志愿者日夜值守中心的电话。
man the telephones = 值守电话
今天也说 staff，不分男女。
⑩ The lighthouse was manned until 1998.
= 那座灯塔一直有人值守到一九九八年。
be manned = 有人值守
⑪ It was the first manned flight to the moon.
= 那是第一次载人登月飞行。
a manned flight = 载人飞行
⑫ The man in the street does not care about these arguments.
= 普通老百姓并不关心这些争论。
the man in the street = 普通人、老百姓
⑬ The workers voted to a man for the strike.
= 工人们无一例外投票赞成罢工。
to a man = 无一例外、全体
字面：到每一个人。
⑭ The two brothers talked man to man about the family business.
= 兄弟俩开诚布公地谈了家族生意的事。
man to man = 坦率地、男人对男人
⑮ He left his father's firm because he wanted to be his own man.
= 他离开了父亲的公司，因为他想自己作主。
be your own man = 自己作主
⑯ He was man enough to admit that he had been wrong.
= 他有胆量承认自己错了。
be man enough to = 有胆量做
⑰ He is a man of his word, so the money will arrive on Friday.
= 他说话算数，所以钱星期五会到。
a man of his word = 说话算数的人
⑱ When his father died, the boy became the man of the house at fourteen.
= 父亲去世后，那个男孩十四岁就成了一家之主。
the man of the house = 一家之主
⑲ His friends told him to man up and say sorry.
= 朋友们叫他拿出男子汉的样子，去道个歉。
man up = （口语）拿出男子汉的样子
这个说法今天常被批评带性别偏见。
⑳ The lake is man-made and was dug in the 1930s.
= 那座湖是人工的，二十世纪三十年代挖成。
man-made = 人造的
与 natural 相对；也说 artificial。
㉑ The job will take about five hundred man-hours.
= 那项活儿大约要五百个工时。
a man-hour = 工时
一个人干一小时的工作量。
㉒ He ate a man-sized breakfast of eggs, sausages and beans.
= 他吃了一顿大份的早饭：鸡蛋、香肠和豆子。
man-sized = 大号的、成人份的
㉓ The villagers shot the man-eater that had killed three people.
= 村民们射杀了那头咬死过三个人的吃人猛兽。
a man-eater = 吃人的野兽
㉔ The film is about a man-eating shark off a holiday beach.
= 那部电影讲的是度假海滩外一条吃人的鲨鱼。
man-eating = 吃人的
㉕ A British man-of-war was waiting outside the harbour.
= 一艘英国军舰在港外等着。
a man-of-war = （旧）军舰
㉖ He was a man of letters who wrote novels, plays and essays.
= 他是个文人，写小说、剧本和随笔。
a man of letters = 文人
㉗ The director's man Friday answers his letters and drives his car.
= 那位主任的得力助手替他回信，还给他开车。
a man Friday = 得力的男助手
出自《鲁滨逊漂流记》里的仆人「星期五」。
㉘ He has turned the garage into a man cave with a huge television.
= 他把车库改成了自己的私人天地，摆了一台巨大的电视。
a man cave = （口语）男人的私人天地
㉙ He carries his laptop in a leather man bag.
= 他用一个皮质男用挎包装笔记本电脑。
a man bag = 男用挎包
㉚ She laughed and said that his cold was only man flu.
= 她笑着说，他那点感冒不过是男人的矫情病。
man flu = （谑）男人小病大养的感冒
㉛ He started going to the gym to get rid of his man boobs.
= 他开始去健身房，想把发福的胸练下去。
man boobs = （口语）男人发福的胸
㉜ Good man management is the most important skill for a football coach.
= 善于带人是足球教练最重要的本事。
man management = （英）对人的管理
㉝ When they could not pay for the car, the repo man came and took it away.
= 他们付不起车钱，收车的人来把车开走了。
a repo man = （美式口语）上门收回欠款货物的人
㉞ Our route man brings fresh bread and milk to the shop every morning before it opens at seven.
= 我们的送货员每天早上七点开门前把新鲜面包和牛奶送到店里。
a route man = （北美）按固定路线送货的人

manacle
/ˈmænəkəl/
核心：（多用复数 manacles）手铐、脚镣；动词：给…上镣铐。
① The three prisoners were led away from the court in heavy iron manacles.
= 那三名囚犯戴着沉重的铁镣铐被押出了法庭。
in manacles = 戴着镣铐
② His hands were manacled behind his back, and a guard stood on each side of him.
= 他的双手被反铐在背后，两边各站着一名看守。
be manacled = 被铐住
拉丁语 manus 是「手」。

manage
/ˈmænɪdʒ/
核心：设法做到、勉强办成（manage to do）；应付、对付过去；管理、经营；管住、驾驭；（时间、钱）安排得过来。
形容词 manageable（可管理的、应付得了的）与 managed（受管理的）并入本条；
managing director（英：总经理）、managing editor（执行主编）、（美）managed care（管理式医疗）也在这里。
① We managed to catch the last train with a minute to spare.
= 我们总算赶上了末班火车，只富余一分钟。
manage to do something = 设法做到…
含「费了劲、差点没成」。
② Can you manage that heavy box on your own?
= 那个沉箱子你一个人搬得动吗？
manage something = 应付得了…
③ I do not know how she manages on such a small wage.
= 我不知道她靠那么点工资是怎么过下来的。
manage on a small wage = 靠微薄的工资过日子
④ She manages a hotel with two hundred rooms.
= 她管理一家有两百间客房的酒店。
manage a hotel = 管理酒店
名词 manager、management。
⑤ The new teacher cannot manage a class of thirty children.
= 新老师管不住一个三十个孩子的班。
manage a class = 管住一个班
⑥ Can you manage lunch on Tuesday?
= 星期二午饭你抽得出时间吗？
manage lunch = 抽得出时间吃午饭
⑦ Break the work into small, manageable pieces.
= 把活儿分成应付得了的小块。
manageable = 应付得了的
⑧ The wood is a managed forest, where every tree that is cut down is replaced.
= 那片林子是有人经营的森林，每砍一棵树就补种一棵。
a managed forest = 有人经营的森林
⑨ She became managing director of the firm at thirty-five.
= 她三十五岁当上了那家公司的总经理。
the managing director = （英）总经理
缩写 MD；美式说 CEO。
⑩ The managing editor decides which stories go on the front page.
= 执行主编决定哪些报道上头版。
the managing editor = 执行主编
⑪ Under managed care, patients must see a doctor chosen by the insurance company.
= 在管理式医疗下，病人必须看保险公司指定的医生。
managed care = （美）管理式医疗

management
/ˈmænɪdʒmənt/
核心：管理、经营；管理层、资方（总称）；（对情况的）处理、应对。
搭配 management consultant（管理顾问）与 management summary（管理摘要）并入本条。
① The shop has done much better under new management.
= 那家店换了经营者之后好多了。
under new management = 换了经营者
店门口常挂的牌子。
② Management has offered the workers a pay rise of three per cent.
= 资方向工人提出加薪百分之三。
management = 资方、管理层
这一支常不加冠词。
③ He took a course in time management.
= 他修了一门时间管理课。
time management = 时间管理
④ The doctors were praised for their management of the crisis.
= 医生们因对那场危机处置得当而受到称赞。
the management of a crisis = 危机的处置
⑤ The firm hired a management consultant to find ways of cutting costs.
= 那家公司请了一位管理顾问来找省钱的办法。
a management consultant = 管理顾问
⑥ The report begins with a one-page management summary.
= 那份报告以一页的管理摘要开头。
a management summary = 管理摘要

manager
/ˈmænɪdʒə(r)/
核心：经理、主管；（球队的）主教练；（歌手、演员的）经纪人。
女经理的旧称 manageress（今天多直接说 manager）与形容词 managerial（管理的、经理的）并入本条。
① I asked to speak to the manager of the hotel.
= 我要求见酒店经理。
the manager of a hotel = 酒店经理
男女都叫 manager。
② The team sacked its manager after six defeats in a row.
= 那支球队六连败后解雇了主教练。
the manager of a team = 球队主教练
英式足球的说法；美式体育里叫 coach。
③ The singer's manager refused to let her talk to reporters.
= 那位歌手的经纪人不让她和记者说话。
the singer's manager = 歌手的经纪人
④ The manageress of the shop gave me my money back.
= 那家店的女经理把钱退给了我。
a manageress = （旧）女经理
⑤ She has ten years of managerial experience in hospitals.
= 她有十年的医院管理经验。
managerial experience = 管理经验

mañana
/mænˈjɑːnə/
核心：（口语）明天；以后再说 —— 西班牙语借词，常带「拖拖拉拉、不着急」的意味。
① I asked when the car would be ready, and the mechanic just smiled and said mañana.
= 我问车什么时候能修好，修车师傅只是笑笑说：明天吧。
mañana = 明天、以后再说
② The builders have a mañana attitude, and the kitchen is still not finished after three months.
= 那些建筑工人总是拖拖拉拉，三个月了厨房还没弄完。
a mañana attitude = 拖拖拉拉的态度
读如 man-yah-nuh。

manatee
/ˈmænətiː/
核心：海牛 —— 生活在热带河口、沿海的大型水生哺乳动物，行动缓慢，吃水草。
① A manatee was feeding on the grass at the bottom of the river.
= 一头海牛正在河底吃水草。
a manatee = 海牛
② Boats must slow down in the bay to avoid hitting the manatees.
= 船只进了海湾必须减速，免得撞到海牛。
avoid hitting the manatees = 避免撞到海牛
旧时水手把它们当成了美人鱼。

Mancunian
/mænˈkjuːniən/

① The singer is a proud Mancunian who still lives near the house where he was born.
= 那位歌手是个自豪的曼彻斯特人，至今住在出生的那座房子附近。

a Mancunian accent = 曼彻斯特口音

mandala
/ˈmændələ/

mandarin
/ˈmændərɪn/
核心：Mandarin —— 普通话、官话；mandarin —— 柑橘、小橘子（也说 mandarin orange）；（旧时中国的）官员；
（英）权力很大的高级文官。mandarin collar（立领）并入本条。
① She is learning Mandarin because her company has an office in Shanghai.
= 她在学普通话，因为公司在上海有办事处。
learn Mandarin = 学普通话
② He peeled a mandarin and gave half to his sister.
= 他剥了一个小橘子，分了一半给妹妹。
a mandarin = 小橘子
③ The real decisions are made by the mandarins in the ministry, not by the minister.
= 真正拿主意的是部里那些高级文官，不是部长。
the mandarins = （英）高级文官
这一支带点讽刺。
④ The jacket has a mandarin collar and silk buttons.
= 那件上衣是立领的，配丝质纽扣。
a mandarin collar = 立领

mandate
/ˈmændeɪt/
核心：（选民给予政府的）授权；（上级的）命令、指令；（历史上的）委任统治（地）。
动词：授权；（美）强制规定。形容词 mandated（依法规定的；委任统治下的）并入本条。
① The party won the election with a clear mandate for reform.
= 那个党赢得选举，得到了推行改革的明确授权。
a mandate for reform = 推行改革的授权
② The troops have a mandate from the United Nations to protect the camps.
= 部队受联合国之命保护难民营。
a mandate from somebody = 某方的授权、指令
③ The law mandates that every new car must have seat belts in the back.
= 法律强制规定每辆新车后排必须有安全带。
mandate that… = 强制规定…
④ The company pays only the mandated minimum wage.
= 那家公司只付法定的最低工资。
the mandated wage = 法定的工资
⑤ The land was held under a British mandate until 1948.
= 那片土地直到一九四八年都处于英国的委任统治之下。
under a mandate = 在委任统治之下

mandatory
/ˈmændətəri/
核心：强制的、法定必须的。
① It is mandatory for all drivers to carry insurance and show it when the police ask.
= 所有司机必须投保，警察要查时还得出示。
it is mandatory to do something = 必须…
② In this country, the offence of murder carries a mandatory life sentence.
= 在这个国家，谋杀罪依法必须判无期徒刑。
a mandatory sentence = 法定必判的刑罚
比 compulsory 更正式，多见于法律条文。

mandible
/ˈmændəbəl/

= 那个头骨除了下颌骨之外是完整的。
the mandible = 下颌骨
② The ant carried a leaf many times its own size in its mandibles.
= 那只蚂蚁用上颚衔着一片比自己大好多倍的叶子。
its mandibles = 它的上颚

mandolin
/ˌmændəˈlɪn/

mane
/meɪn/

manful
/ˈmænfəl/

① He made a manful attempt to finish the huge plate of food.

manga
/ˈmæŋɡə/

manganese
/ˈmæŋɡəniːz/

mange
/meɪndʒ/

manger
/ˈmeɪndʒə(r)/

mania
/ˈmeɪniə/
核心：狂热、痴迷（a mania for）；（医）躁狂症。也作后一成分：-mania（…狂、…热）。
名词 maniac（疯子；…迷）与形容词 maniacal（疯狂的）、副词 maniacally 并入本条。
① She has a mania for collecting old teapots and owns more than two hundred.
= 她痴迷于收集旧茶壶，已有两百多把。
a mania for something = 对…的痴迷
带点「过了头」的意思。
② Football mania swept the country during the World Cup.
= 世界杯期间，足球热席卷全国。
football mania = 足球热
③ The patient suffers from periods of mania followed by deep sadness.
= 那位病人先是一阵阵躁狂，接着陷入深深的悲伤。
periods of mania = 一阵阵躁狂
④ Some maniac overtook me on the bend at ninety miles an hour.
= 有个疯子以每小时九十英里的速度在弯道上超了我的车。
a maniac = 疯子
⑤ My brother is a fishing maniac who spends every weekend by the river.
= 我哥哥是个钓鱼迷，每个周末都泡在河边。
a fishing maniac = 钓鱼迷
⑥ The villain in the film has a maniacal laugh that frightens the children.
= 影片里那个反派有一种吓人的疯狂笑声，孩子们听了害怕。
a maniacal laugh = 疯狂的笑声
⑦ He was grinning maniacally as he drove the old car down the hill.
= 他开着那辆旧车冲下山时，咧着嘴疯了似的笑。
grin maniacally = 疯了似的咧嘴笑

manic
/ˈmænɪk/
核心：（口语）忙乱的、狂热的、兴奋过头的；（医）躁狂的。副词 manically 并入本条。
旧称 manic depression（躁郁症，今天叫 bipolar disorder）与 manic-depressive（躁郁症的；躁郁症患者）也在这里。
① It has been a manic week at the office, with three people off sick.
= 办公室这个星期忙疯了，有三个人请了病假。
a manic week = 忙疯了的一周
口语里的夸张，不是真的病。
② The children ran around the garden with manic energy until bedtime.
= 孩子们精力过剩地在花园里疯跑，一直跑到睡觉时间。
manic energy = 过剩的精力
③ He worked manically for a month to finish the book on time.
= 他疯了似的干了一个月，按时把书写完。
work manically = 疯了似的干
④ The painter suffered from manic depression for most of his life.
= 那位画家大半辈子受躁郁症折磨。
manic depression = 躁郁症（旧称）
⑤ The doctor explained that her father was a manic-depressive and needed regular medicine.
= 医生解释说，她父亲患有躁郁症，需要按时服药。
a manic-depressive = 躁郁症患者

manicure
/ˈmænɪkjʊə(r)/
核心：修指甲、美甲（手部护理）。动词：给…修指甲。
形容词 manicured（指甲修剪整齐的；（花园、草坪）修剪得一丝不苟的）与 manicurist（美甲师）并入本条。
① She has a manicure every two weeks at the salon near her office.
= 她每两周在办公室附近的美容店做一次美甲。
have a manicure = 做美甲
拉丁语 manus（手）加 cura（护理）。
② The hotel stands in beautifully manicured gardens.
= 那家酒店坐落在修剪得一丝不苟的花园里。
manicured gardens = 修剪整齐的花园
③ She tapped the table with her perfectly manicured nails.
= 她用修剪得无可挑剔的指甲敲着桌子。
manicured nails = 修剪整齐的指甲
④ The manicurist painted each nail a different colour.
= 美甲师把每个指甲涂成了不同的颜色。
a manicurist = 美甲师
脚部护理是 pedicure。

manifest
/ˈmænɪfest/
核心：（正式）明显的、显而易见的；动词：表明、显示；（症状、情绪）表现出来（manifest itself）。
名词：（船、飞机的）货单、旅客名单。副词 manifestly 并入本条；历史用语 manifest destiny（昭昭天命）也在这里。
① His relief was manifest to everyone in the room.
= 他松了一口气，屋里的人都看得出来。
be manifest = 明显
比 obvious 正式得多。
② The workers manifested their anger by walking out of the meeting.
= 工人们以退场表示愤怒。
manifest your anger = 表示愤怒
③ The illness usually manifests itself as a rash on the arms.
= 那种病通常表现为胳膊上起皮疹。
manifest itself = 表现出来
主语多是病、问题、情绪。
④ His name was not on the ship's passenger manifest.
= 那艘船的旅客名单上没有他的名字。
a passenger manifest = 旅客名单
这一支是名词，航运、航空用语。
⑤ The decision was manifestly unfair to the younger workers.
= 那个决定对年轻工人明显不公。
manifestly unfair = 明显不公
⑥ In the nineteenth century, many Americans believed in the manifest destiny of their country to reach the Pacific.
= 十九世纪，许多美国人相信自己的国家注定要扩张到太平洋。
manifest destiny = 昭昭天命

manifestation
/ˌmænɪfeˈsteɪʃən/
核心：（正式）表现、体现；（鬼魂、神灵的）显现。
① The riots were a manifestation of anger about rising prices.
= 那些骚乱是对物价上涨的愤怒的一种表现。
a manifestation of anger = 愤怒的表现
来自动词 manifest。
② A rash is often the first manifestation of the disease.
= 皮疹往往是那种病最早的表现。
the first manifestation = 最早的表现
③ The villagers spoke of ghostly manifestations in the old church.
= 村民们说那座老教堂里有鬼魂显现。
ghostly manifestations = 鬼魂显现

manifesto
/ˌmænɪˈfestəʊ/
核心：宣言、（政党的）竞选纲领。复数 manifestos。
① The party promised lower taxes in its election manifesto.
= 那个党在竞选纲领里承诺减税。
an election manifesto = 竞选纲领
英国各党大选前都要发布。
② The young painters published a manifesto calling for a new kind of art.
= 那些年轻画家发表了一份宣言，呼吁一种新的艺术。
publish a manifesto = 发表宣言
和 manifest 同源：把主张公之于众。

manifold
/ˈmænɪfəʊld/
核心：（正式）多种多样的、许许多多的；名词：（发动机的）歧管。
① The reasons for the company's failure are manifold.
= 那家公司失败的原因是多方面的。
be manifold = 多方面的
many 加 fold（倍、重）。
② The new job brought manifold opportunities to travel and learn.
= 那份新工作带来了许许多多旅行和学习的机会。
manifold opportunities = 许许多多的机会
③ The mechanic found a crack in the exhaust manifold.
= 修车师傅在排气歧管上发现了一道裂缝。
the exhaust manifold = 排气歧管

manipulate
/məˈnɪpjʊleɪt/
核心：（贬）操纵、摆布（人、舆论、数字）；熟练地操作、摆弄；（医）推拿、正骨。
名词 manipulation、形容词 manipulative（爱摆布人的；操作的）、名词 manipulator（操纵者）并入本条。
① He knows how to manipulate people into doing what he wants.
= 他懂得怎么摆布别人去做他想让他们做的事。
manipulate somebody into doing something = 摆布某人去做…
② The company was accused of manipulating the figures to hide its losses.
= 那家公司被指篡改数字掩盖亏损。
manipulate the figures = 篡改数字
这一支含贬义：动了手脚。
③ The pilot learns to manipulate the controls without looking at them.
= 飞行员要学会不看操纵杆就能操作。
manipulate the controls = 操作控制装置
这一支是中性的：用手熟练操作。
④ The osteopath manipulated his back to ease the pain.
= 正骨师给他的后背做了推拿以缓解疼痛。
manipulate somebody's back = 给某人后背做推拿
⑤ The film is a study of the manipulation of public opinion.
= 那部电影探讨的是对舆论的操纵。
the manipulation of something = 对…的操纵
⑥ She is a manipulative woman who turns her friends against each other.
= 她是个爱摆布人的女人，让朋友们反目成仇。
manipulative = 爱摆布人的
⑦ He is a clever manipulator of the press.
= 他很会操纵新闻界。
a manipulator = 操纵者
拉丁语 manus 是「手」。

mankind
/ˌmænˈkaɪnd/
核心：人类（总称）。不可数。今天更中性的说法是 humankind、humanity。
① The discovery of fire changed the history of mankind.
= 火的发现改变了人类的历史。
the history of mankind = 人类的历史
man 在这里是「人」，不专指男人。
② The doctor said that the new drug could be of great benefit to mankind.
= 那位医生说，那种新药可能造福人类。
benefit to mankind = 造福人类

manky
/ˈmæŋki/
核心：（英，口语）脏兮兮的、破旧邋遢的。
① Take off that manky old jumper and put on a clean shirt.
= 把那件脏兮兮的旧套头衫脱了，换件干净衬衫。
a manky jumper = 脏兮兮的套头衫
英国年轻人的口头词。
② There was a manky piece of cheese at the back of the fridge.
= 冰箱最里面有一块发了霉的脏奶酪。
a manky piece of cheese = 脏兮兮的奶酪

manly
/ˈmænli/
核心：有男子气概的、适合男子的（旧式的赞语）。名词 manliness 并入本条。
① He has a deep, manly voice and a firm handshake.
= 他嗓音低沉有男子气，握手很有力。
a manly voice = 有男子气的嗓音
今天听来有点老派。
② His father thought that crying was not manly.
= 他父亲觉得哭不像个男子汉。
not manly = 不像男子汉
③ The old school taught boys that manliness meant never showing fear.
= 那所老学校教男孩们：男子气概就是永远不露惧色。
manliness = 男子气概
是形容词，虽然以 -ly 结尾。

manna
/ˈmænə/
核心：（《圣经》里）吗哪 —— 上帝在荒野中降给以色列人的食物；manna from heaven（天赐之物、及时雨）。
① The Bible says that manna fell from the sky to feed the people in the desert.
= 《圣经》说，吗哪从天而降，养活了沙漠里的众人。
manna = 吗哪
② The unexpected cheque was manna from heaven for the young couple.
= 那张意外的支票对那对年轻夫妇来说真是及时雨。
manna from heaven = 天赐之物、及时雨

mannequin
/ˈmænɪkɪn/
核心：（橱窗、服装店里的）人体模型；（旧）时装模特。
① The shop window was full of mannequins in summer dresses.
= 橱窗里摆满了穿夏裙的人体模型。
a mannequin = 人体模型
也说 shop dummy。
② She stood as still as a mannequin while the tailor pinned the dress.
= 裁缝别衣服的时候，她像个人体模型似的一动不动。
as still as a mannequin = 像人体模型一样一动不动
法语借词，读如 man-i-kin。

manner
/ˈmænə(r)/
核心：方式、方法；（待人的）态度、举止；（复数 manners）礼貌、规矩；（复数）风俗习惯。
习语：good manners / bad manners（有礼貌 / 没礼貌）、table manners（餐桌礼仪）、all manner of（各种各样的）、
in a manner of speaking（可以这么说）、as if to the manner born（像天生就会似的）。
形容词 mannered（举止做作的；也作后一成分，如 well-mannered 有礼貌的）并入本条。
① She answered the question in a calm and friendly manner.
= 她以平静友好的方式回答了那个问题。
in a friendly manner = 以友好的方式
比 way 正式。
② The doctor has a kind manner that puts patients at ease.
= 那位医生态度和蔼，让病人安心。
a kind manner = 和蔼的态度
这一支用单数：待人的样子。
③ It is bad manners to talk with your mouth full.
= 嘴里含着东西说话是没礼貌的。
bad manners = 没礼貌
这一支用复数。
④ The children have very good manners and always say thank you.
= 那些孩子很有礼貌，总是说谢谢。
good manners = 有礼貌
⑤ His table manners are terrible; he eats with his elbows on the table.
= 他的餐桌礼仪糟透了，吃饭时把胳膊肘支在桌上。
table manners = 餐桌礼仪
⑥ The shop sells all manner of things, from nails to wedding cakes.
= 那家店什么都卖，从钉子到结婚蛋糕。
all manner of = 各种各样的
这里 manner 是旧义「种类」。
⑦ He is, in a manner of speaking, the father of the modern computer.
= 可以这么说，他是现代计算机之父。
in a manner of speaking = 可以这么说
⑧ She took to life in the palace as if to the manner born.
= 她适应宫里的生活，就像生来如此。
to the manner born = 像天生就会似的
⑨ He is a quiet, well-mannered boy who is liked by all his teachers.
= 他是个文静有礼的男孩，老师们都喜欢他。
well-mannered = 有礼貌的
⑩ The critics found her acting stiff and mannered.
= 评论家觉得她的表演僵硬做作。
mannered = 做作的

mannerism
/ˈmænərɪzəm/
核心：（个人说话、动作上的）习惯性小动作、习气；（艺术上）矫饰主义、风格主义。mannerist（矫饰主义的；矫饰主义画家）并入本条。
① He has a mannerism of touching his ear when he is nervous.
= 他一紧张就有摸耳朵的小动作。
a mannerism = 习惯性的小动作
本人往往不自觉。
② The actor copied the president's voice and mannerisms perfectly.
= 那位演员把总统的嗓音和习惯动作模仿得惟妙惟肖。
copy somebody's mannerisms = 模仿某人的习惯动作
③ The gallery has a room of mannerist paintings from sixteenth-century Italy.
= 那家美术馆有一间展厅陈列十六世纪意大利的矫饰主义绘画。
mannerist paintings = 矫饰主义绘画

mannish
/ˈmænɪʃ/
核心：（贬）（女人、女装）男子气的、像男人的。
① She wore a mannish suit and a tie to the wedding.
= 她穿了一身男式西装、打着领带去参加婚礼。
a mannish suit = 男式的西装
② The magazine described the singer's deep, mannish voice.
= 那本杂志描写了那位女歌手低沉、像男人的嗓音。
a mannish voice = 像男人的嗓音
常含不赞许，用时小心。

mano a mano
/ˌmænəʊ ɑː ˈmænəʊ/
核心：（口语）一对一地、面对面较量 —— 西班牙语借词，字面是「手对手」。
① The two champions will meet mano a mano in the final on Sunday.
= 两位冠军星期天将在决赛中一对一较量。
meet mano a mano = 一对一较量
② He wanted to settle the argument mano a mano, without lawyers.
= 他想当面把争执了结，不找律师。
settle something mano a mano = 当面了结…

manoeuvre
/məˈnuːvə(r)/
核心：熟练而小心的移动、操作；策略、花招；（复数）军事演习。动词：巧妙地移动、操纵；耍手腕。美式拼 maneuver。
习语 room for manoeuvre（回旋余地）。
形容词 manoeuvrable（易操纵的，美式 maneuverable）、名词 manoeuvrability、manoeuvring（耍手腕，美式 maneuvering）并入本条。
① Parking the lorry in the narrow street was a difficult manoeuvre.
= 把卡车停进那条窄街是个很难的动作。
a difficult manoeuvre = 很难的动作
读如 muh-noo-ver。
② The offer was a clever manoeuvre to win the support of the smaller parties.
= 那个提议是争取小党支持的一招妙棋。
a clever manoeuvre = 一招妙棋
③ The army is on manoeuvres in the hills this week.
= 军队这个星期在山里演习。
on manoeuvres = 在演习
这一支用复数。
④ She manoeuvred the car into a tiny space between two vans.
= 她把车巧妙地挪进了两辆货车之间的一个小空位。
manoeuvre a car = 巧妙地挪车
⑤ He manoeuvred his way into the top job within two years.
= 他耍手腕，两年之内就爬上了最高职位。
manoeuvre your way into something = 耍手腕进入…
⑥ The new rules leave the minister very little room for manoeuvre.
= 新规定让部长几乎没有回旋余地。
room for manoeuvre = 回旋余地
⑦ The small boat is light and highly manoeuvrable.
= 那条小船轻便，很好操纵。
manoeuvrable = 易操纵的
⑧ The pilot praised the manoeuvrability of the new plane.
= 飞行员称赞了新飞机的操纵性。
manoeuvrability = 操纵性
⑨ After weeks of political manoeuvring, a new leader was chosen.
= 经过几个星期的政治运作，新领袖选了出来。
political manoeuvring = 政治运作
⑩ The American newspaper reported that the driver tried to maneuver around the truck.
= 那家美国报纸报道说，司机试图绕过那辆卡车。
maneuver = manoeuvre 的美式拼法
⑪ The advert says that the bike is light, maneuverable and easy to park.
= 广告上说那辆车轻便、好操纵、好停放。
maneuverable = manoeuvrable 的美式拼法
⑫ The senator was known for skilful maneuvering behind the scenes.
= 那位参议员以幕后运作的手腕出名。
maneuvering = manoeuvring 的美式拼法

manor
/ˈmænə(r)/
核心：（英）庄园；庄园主的宅邸（也说 manor house）；（英，俚）（警察的）辖区。形容词 manorial 并入本条。
① The family has owned the manor since the sixteenth century.
= 那个家族从十六世纪起就拥有那座庄园。
the manor = 庄园
中世纪领主的领地。
② The old manor house is now a hotel with forty rooms.
= 那座古老的庄园宅邸如今是一家有四十间客房的酒店。
a manor house = 庄园宅邸
③ The detective knew every thief on his manor.
= 那位侦探认识自己辖区里的每一个贼。
his manor = （英，俚）他的辖区
④ The records of the manorial court go back to the year 1350.
= 那个庄园法庭的记录可以追溯到一三五〇年。
the manorial court = 庄园法庭

manpower
/ˈmænpaʊə(r)/
核心：人力、劳动力 —— 完成某项工作所需的人手。
① The police do not have the manpower to watch every street.
= 警方没有那么多人手去盯每一条街。
have the manpower = 有人手
不可数。
② The farm suffers from a shortage of manpower at harvest time.
= 那座农场收割时节人手短缺。
a shortage of manpower = 人手短缺
今天也说 workforce、staffing。

manservant
/ˈmænsɜːvənt/
核心：（旧）男仆。复数 menservants。
① The old duke was dressed every morning by his manservant.
= 老公爵每天早上由男仆伺候穿衣。
his manservant = 他的男仆
② In the novel, a clever manservant saves his master from one disaster after another.
= 小说里，一个聪明的男仆一次又一次把主人从灾祸中救出来。
a clever manservant = 聪明的男仆

mansion
/ˈmænʃən/
核心：大宅、豪宅、公馆。
① The film star lives in a mansion with twenty rooms and a swimming pool.
= 那位影星住在一座有二十个房间和一个游泳池的豪宅里。
a mansion = 豪宅
比 house 大得多、气派得多。
② The old mansion on the hill has been empty for years.
= 山上那座老宅空了多年。
the old mansion = 老宅
英国公寓楼的名字里常用 Mansions。

manslaughter
/ˈmænslɔːtə(r)/
核心：（法律）过失杀人（罪）—— 非蓄意地致人死亡，比 murder（谋杀）轻。
① The driver was found guilty of manslaughter and sent to prison for six years.
= 那名司机被判过失杀人罪，入狱六年。
guilty of manslaughter = 犯过失杀人罪
② The charge was reduced from murder to manslaughter.
= 罪名从谋杀降为过失杀人。
reduced to manslaughter = 降为过失杀人
slaughter 是「屠杀」。

mansplain
/ˈmænspleɪn/
核心：（口语，贬）（男人）居高临下地给女人讲她本来就懂的事。名词 mansplaining 并入本条。
① He tried to mansplain the rules of chess to a woman who had been national champion.
= 他想给一位当过全国冠军的女士讲解国际象棋规则。
mansplain something to somebody = 居高临下地给某人讲…
② She was tired of the mansplaining at every meeting.
= 她受够了每次开会都有人居高临下地指点她。
mansplaining = 男人居高临下的说教
man 加 explain 的拼合词。

mantelpiece
/ˈmæntəlpiːs/
核心：壁炉台 —— 壁炉上方放东西的搁板。也说 mantel（美式）。
① She keeps the family photographs on the mantelpiece.
= 她把全家的照片摆在壁炉台上。
on the mantelpiece = 在壁炉台上
英国人家摆钟、照片、贺卡的地方。
② An old clock ticked on the mantelpiece above the fire.
= 壁炉上方的台子上，一座老钟滴答作响。
the mantelpiece above the fire = 壁炉上方的台子

mantis
/ˈmæntɪs/
核心：螳螂。也说 praying mantis（因前足合拢像在祈祷）。
① A green mantis sat on the leaf, waiting for a fly.
= 一只绿螳螂蹲在叶子上，等着苍蝇飞来。
a mantis = 螳螂
复数 mantises 或 mantids。
② The praying mantis turned its head to watch us as we passed.
= 我们走过时，那只螳螂转过头来盯着我们。
a praying mantis = 螳螂

mantle
/ˈmæntəl/
核心：（文）覆盖层（a mantle of snow）；（职责、地位的）衣钵、重任；（地球的）地幔；（旧）披风、斗篷。
① A mantle of snow covered the hills.
= 山丘披上了一层雪。
a mantle of snow = 一层雪
由「披风」引申：像披了一层。
② She took on the mantle of leader after her father retired.
= 父亲退休后，她接过了领导的重任。
take on the mantle of = 接过…的衣钵
③ The earth's mantle lies between the crust and the core.
= 地幔位于地壳和地核之间。
the earth's mantle = 地幔
④ The queen in the painting wears a blue mantle lined with fur.
= 画里的王后披着一件毛皮衬里的蓝色披风。
a mantle = （旧）披风

mantra
/ˈmæntrə/
核心：（印度教、佛教的）真言、咒语 —— 冥想时反复念诵的词句；（比喻）反复念叨的口号、信条。
① The monks repeated the mantra for an hour before dawn.
= 拂晓前，僧人们把那句真言念诵了一个小时。
repeat a mantra = 念诵真言
梵语「思想的工具」。
② The company's mantra is that the customer is always right.
= 那家公司的口头禅是「顾客永远是对的」。
the company's mantra = 公司的口头禅
这一支是比喻，今天更常见。

manual
/ˈmænjuəl/
核心：手工的、体力的；手动的（与 automatic 相对）；名词：说明书、手册；手动挡汽车。副词 manually 并入本条。
① He has done manual work on building sites all his life.
= 他一辈子在建筑工地上干体力活。
manual work = 体力活
manual worker：体力劳动者。
② The camera has both automatic and manual controls.
= 那台相机既有自动控制也有手动控制。
manual controls = 手动控制
③ Read the manual carefully before you switch the machine on.
= 开机之前先仔细看说明书。
the manual = 说明书
也说 instruction manual。
④ I learned to drive in a manual and find automatic cars strange.
= 我是开手动挡学的车，觉得自动挡的车开着别扭。
a manual = 手动挡汽车
⑤ The old gates have to be opened manually.
= 那些旧大门得用手开。
manually = 用手、手动地
拉丁语 manus 是「手」。

manufacture
/ˌmænjʊˈfæktʃə(r)/
核心：（用机器大量）制造、生产；（贬）编造、捏造（借口、证据）。名词：制造、生产。
名词 manufacturer（制造商）与 manufacturing（制造业）并入本条。
① The factory manufactures engines for buses and lorries.
= 那家工厂生产公交车和卡车的发动机。
manufacture engines = 生产发动机
多指工厂里成批地造。
② The police were accused of manufacturing evidence against him.
= 警方被指捏造对他不利的证据。
manufacture evidence = 捏造证据
③ The manufacture of cars has moved to cheaper countries.
= 汽车制造已转移到成本更低的国家。
the manufacture of something = …的制造
④ If the machine breaks down, send it back to the manufacturer.
= 机器要是坏了，寄回给厂家。
the manufacturer = 制造商、厂家
说明书上常见：按厂家说明使用。
⑤ Jobs in manufacturing have fallen by half in twenty years.
= 二十年里，制造业的岗位减少了一半。
manufacturing = 制造业
字面：用手（manu）做（facture）。

manure
/məˈnjʊə(r)/
核心：（牲畜的）粪肥。动词：给…施粪肥。
① The farmer spread manure on the fields in early spring.
= 早春时节，农夫往田里撒粪肥。
spread manure = 撒粪肥
不可数。
② The roses grow well because we manure the bed every winter.
= 那些玫瑰长得好，因为我们每年冬天给花圃施粪肥。
manure the bed = 给花圃施粪肥
化肥是 fertilizer。

manuscript
/ˈmænjʊskrɪpt/
核心：手稿、原稿（尚未印成书的稿子）；（印刷术出现前的）手抄本。manuscript paper（五线谱纸）并入本条。
① She sent the manuscript of her first novel to twenty publishers.
= 她把头一部小说的稿子寄给了二十家出版社。
the manuscript of a novel = 小说的手稿
今天打印稿、电子稿也叫 manuscript。
② The library owns a manuscript copied by monks in the ninth century.
= 那座图书馆藏有一部九世纪僧侣抄写的手抄本。

③ The poem survives only in manuscript.
= 那首诗只有手稿流传下来。
in manuscript = 以手稿形式
④ He wrote the tune down on a sheet of manuscript paper.
= 他把曲调记在了一张五线谱纸上。
manuscript paper = 五线谱纸
缩写 MS。

Manx
/mæŋks/
核心：马恩岛的；马恩岛人；马恩语。Manx cat（马恩岛猫：一种没有尾巴的猫）并入本条。
① The Manx parliament is one of the oldest in the world.
= 马恩岛的议会是世界上最古老的议会之一。

many
/ˈmeni/
核心：许多的、很多的 —— 接可数名词复数（不可数用 much）。代词：许多人、许多个。比较级 more，最高级 most。
多用于否定句、疑问句和 so / too / as / how 之后；肯定句口语里常说 a lot of。
句型与习语：how many（多少）、too many（太多）、so many（这么多）、as many as（多达；和…一样多）、
a good many / a great many（很多）、many a（正式：许多，接单数）、the many（多数人）、
one too many（多了一个；多喝了一杯）。
① I do not have many friends in this city.
= 我在这座城里朋友不多。
not many friends = 朋友不多
否定句里最自然。
② How many people came to the meeting?
= 来开会的有多少人？
how many = 多少
问可数名词；不可数用 how much。
③ There are too many cars on the roads in the morning.
= 早上路上的车太多了。
too many = 太多
不可数用 too much。
④ I have never seen so many birds in one tree.
= 我从没见过一棵树上有这么多鸟。
so many = 这么多
⑤ As many as five hundred people may lose their jobs.
= 可能有多达五百人丢掉工作。
as many as = 多达
⑥ Take as many apples as you can carry.
= 你拿得动多少苹果就拿多少。
as many as you can = 能…多少就…多少
⑦ Many of the houses in the village are empty.
= 村里许多房子是空的。
many of = …中的许多
后面接 the、these、my 等限定词。
⑧ A good many people disagree with the new law.
= 相当多的人不赞同那项新法律。
a good many = 很多
也说 a great many，更多。
⑨ Many a young man has left the island to look for work.
= 许多年轻人离开那座岛去找工作。
many a = （正式）许多
后面接单数名词、单数动词。
⑩ The government should serve the many, not the few.
= 政府应当为多数人服务，而不是为少数人。
the many = 多数人
⑪ He had one too many at the party and fell asleep on the sofa.
= 他在聚会上多喝了一杯，在沙发上睡着了。
one too many = 多喝了一杯
⑫ Many thanks for the lovely flowers.
= 非常感谢你送的漂亮花。
many thanks = 非常感谢

Maoism
/ˈmaʊɪzəm/
核心：毛泽东思想、毛主义。Maoist（毛主义的；毛主义者）并入本条。

Maoist rebels = 毛派叛军

a Maoist = 毛主义者

Maori
/ˈmaʊri/

① The Maori arrived in New Zealand by canoe about seven hundred years ago.

map
/mæp/
核心：地图；（星空、基因等的）分布图。动词：绘制…的地图；摸清、测定。
短语动词：map out（详细规划）、map onto / map on（把…对应到）。习语 put somebody / something on the map（使出名）、
off the map（偏僻的；消失的）。名词 mapping（绘图；对应关系）并入本条。
① Can you find the village on the map?
= 你能在地图上找到那个村子吗？
on the map = 在地图上
介词用 on。
② We bought a street map of the city at the station.
= 我们在车站买了一张那座城市的街道图。
a street map = 街道图
③ The explorers mapped the coast of the island in 1820.
= 探险者们在一八二〇年绘制了那座岛的海岸图。
map the coast = 绘制海岸图
④ Scientists have mapped the genes of the rice plant.
= 科学家已经测定了水稻的基因图谱。
map the genes = 测定基因图谱
⑤ She has mapped out her career for the next ten years.
= 她把今后十年的职业道路都规划好了。
map out = 详细规划
像画地图一样把路线标好。
⑥ The festival put the little town on the map.
= 那个节庆让这座小城出了名。
put something on the map = 使…出名
⑦ The program maps each name onto a number.
= 那个程序把每个名字对应到一个数字。
map onto = 把…对应到
map on = 把…对应到（同上）
⑧ The mapping of the sea floor has taken many years.
= 海底测绘花了很多年。
the mapping of something = …的测绘
⑨ The farm is miles off the map, at the end of a long track.
= 那座农场偏僻得很，在一条长长的土路尽头。
off the map = 偏僻的
⑩ The classroom wall had a relief map showing the mountains in brown and the sea in blue.
= 教室墙上挂着一张立体地图，山是棕色的，海是蓝色的。
a relief map = 立体地图
⑪ We got lost because the road map in the car was ten years old.
= 车里的公路地图是十年前的，我们就迷路了。
a road map = 公路地图
⑫ The government has published a road map for reducing pollution over the next twenty years.
= 政府公布了今后二十年减少污染的路线图。
a road map = （达到目标的）路线图、计划

maple
/ˈmeɪpəl/
核心：枫树、槭树；枫木。搭配 maple syrup（枫糖浆）、maple sugar（枫糖）、maple leaf（枫叶，加拿大的象征）并入本条。
① The maples along the road turn red and gold in autumn.
= 路边的枫树秋天变成红色和金色。

加拿大的国树。
② The back of the violin is carved from a single piece of pale maple.
= 那把小提琴的背板是用一整块浅色枫木雕成的。
carved from maple = 用枫木雕成的
③ We had pancakes with maple syrup for breakfast.
= 我们早饭吃的是薄煎饼配枫糖浆。
maple syrup = 枫糖浆
枫树汁熬成，北美早餐常用。
④ The shop sells sweets made of maple sugar.
= 那家店卖枫糖做的糖果。
maple sugar = 枫糖
⑤ The Canadian flag has a red maple leaf in the middle.
= 加拿大国旗中央有一片红枫叶。
a maple leaf = 枫叶

mar
/mɑː(r)/
核心：（正式）破坏、损害、玷污 —— 使原本美好的东西有了瑕疵。
① The wedding was marred by heavy rain in the afternoon.

maracas

Marathi

marathon
/ˈmærəθən/

① She ran her first marathon at the age of fifty.

a marathoner = 马拉松选手

/ˈmɑːbəl/

march
/mɑːtʃ/
核心：齐步走、行军；（示威者）游行；大步坚定地走；押着（某人）走。名词：行军；游行；进行曲；（事态的）进展。
短语动词 march on（向…进军；继续前进）。习语 on the march（在行军中；在迅速发展）。
名词 marcher（游行者）、march-past（分列式）、marching band（行进乐队）、marching season（北爱尔兰的游行季）并入本条。
① The soldiers marched thirty miles in a single day.
= 士兵们一天行军三十英里。
march thirty miles = 行军三十英里
本义：军队整齐地走。
② Thousands of people marched through the capital to protest against the war.
= 成千上万的人在首都游行，抗议那场战争。
march through the capital = 在首都游行
名词也是 march：a protest march。
③ She marched into the office and demanded to see the manager.
= 她大步走进办公室，要求见经理。
march into the office = 大步走进办公室
带着怒气或决心。
④ The guards marched the prisoner back to his cell.
= 看守把那名囚犯押回了牢房。
march somebody back = 把某人押回去
⑤ The army began its march on the capital at dawn.
= 军队拂晓时开始向首都进军。
a march on the capital = 向首都进军
⑥ The band played a slow march as the coffin was carried in.
= 灵柩抬进来时，乐队奏起一支缓慢的进行曲。
a march = 进行曲
⑦ The rebels marched on the capital from the north.
= 叛军从北面向首都进军。
march on = 向…进军
⑧ Science is on the march, and new discoveries are made every week.
= 科学在突飞猛进，每周都有新发现。
on the march = 在迅速发展；在行军中
⑨ Nothing can stop the march of time.
= 什么也挡不住时间的脚步。
the march of time = 时间的推移
⑩ Police say that five thousand marchers took part in the protest.
= 警方说有五千名游行者参加了抗议。
a marcher = 游行者
参加示威游行的人。
⑪ The president watched the march-past from a stand in the square.
= 总统在广场的看台上观看了分列式。
a march-past = 分列式
⑫ She plays the drum in the school marching band.
= 她在学校的行进乐队里打鼓。
a marching band = 行进乐队
⑬ Extra police were sent to the town during the marching season.
= 游行季期间，那座城镇增派了警察。
the marching season = （北爱尔兰的）游行季
另有月份名 March（三月），首字母大写。
⑭ The new soldiers were sent on a twenty-mile route march across the hills with heavy packs on their backs.
= 新兵们背着沉重的背包，被派去翻山进行二十英里的长途行军。
a route march = 长途行军（训练）

marchioness
/ˌmɑːʃəˈnes/
